It features complex terrain with significant elevation differences and strategically hidden points throughout the urban environment.[/p][p][/p][p]The map is designed to support [b]fast-paced combat and dynamic tactical play[/b], with structures that facilitate both attacking and defending. notes.title: July Update Note
notes.content:
[p]Mercenaries![/p][p]The July Update Is Here![/p][p]Get ready for new content and exciting changes![/p][p][/p][h1]New Annihilation Map : Anaconda Core[/h1][p][b]\[What is Core Map?][/b][/p][p]Core Map Content offers a fresh take on the strategic and tactical hotspots within existing maps. It reinterprets and reintroduces areas where key engagements typically unfold.[/p][p]For this iteration, Anaconda: Core, we've modified three crucial combat zones from the original map layout.[/p][p]Firstly, we've opened up the entrances to the central engagement area, which previously acted as a bridge, allowing for horizontal flanking maneuvers into enemy territory. This changes the combat flow from primarily vertical engagements to now include broader horizontal pushes.[/p][p]Furthermore, we've reconfigured the pathways into each faction's territory, making them accessible to all teams. This adjustment encourages more dynamic back-line infiltration and allows for the proactive use of defensive positions.[/p][p]By altering these core structural elements, we aim to deliver more thrilling gameplay, enabling players to secure victory through a wider array of strategies and tactics.[/p][p]We appreciate your keen interest and participation![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0aaba20b2a090e9d5d75b8481475bd3aa25e52af.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/3127c41401e79db0531fa9788ba9821aaccfce6a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/42e63cf1e8e93b3d1cbc61284ce09db17a4647c4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/f6d5dff047a4dd3e8a18e5985cd267b6d3417dba.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]Weapon Balance Update[/h1][h3][b]1. notes.title: Outpost: Level Designer Interview (+ Coupon & Play Event!)
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

Get ready for an exciting new experience in AVA Global—[b]Outpost (Control Mode)[/b] is now live and available to play!
This fresh addition brings a whole new dynamic to your battles, with strategic gameplay and new features to keep you on your toes!

Let’s dive into what makes this new addition so special:

[h1]Outpost Level Designer Interview[/h1]

[h3]Q1: Can you introduce Outpost (Control Mode) and explain how it works?[/h3]

[b]★Level Designer★: [/b]Sure![b] Outpost (Control Mode[/b]) is a capture and elimination-based mode where two teams fight to control three flag points on the map. At the beginning of each round, the flags are neutral, and both teams will battle to secure them. Once a team captures a flag, they activate both personal and team buffs, which make them stronger for a limited time. If you get kills while the buffs are active, you earn additional bonus points for your team. The team that reaches the target score first wins the round.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/9037a5f136597e47746c493f385ae1a4a3119c36.jpg[/img]

[h3]Q2: What new features and systems have been added to Control Mode?[/h3]

[b]★Level Designer★: [/b]We’ve introduced a[b] Boost Jump [/b]feature that allows players to jump higher than normal, adding new movement opportunities. This makes it easier to cross over into enemy territory or surprise opponents from unexpected angles. The [b]Outpost map[/b] is designed with vertical elements to make full use of this mechanic, giving players new strategies to explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/5a5ef25f24ac3e2aa00dac72472c1742adbe71d0.jpg[/img]
PLAYOUTPOST1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/bde3508763d9ad62f5502d125f30cffe0df88318.png[/img]
Additionally, we’ve added [b]five special skills[/b] that players can use to gain an edge in battle. These skills are charged by contributing to flag captures and getting kills. They include:
[list]
[*] [b]SCAN:[/b] Detects enemies within 50m in real-time
[*] [b]Dash Bomb:[/b] Teleports and explodes at the destination
[*] [b]Sniper Pistol:[/b] A one-shot pistol that eliminates enemies with precision
[*] [b]M202:[/b] A four-shot rocket launcher
[*] [b]GM94:[/b] A wide-area grenade launcher
(You can use skills with the F key. Secondary slot weapons cannot be used.)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/561a25357b1a702a71fc51f2915bb77a4c26e9d3.jpg[/img]
[i]<Skill gauge charging (left), Skill gauge fully charged (right)>[/i]

These skills add another layer of strategy, allowing players to tailor their playstyle to their preferred tactics.

[h3]Q3: Can you tell us more about the Outpost map and its design?[/h3]

[b]★Level Designer★: [/b][u]Outpost is designed specifically for Control Mode.[/u] The map is structured in a + shape, making it easy to circulate and move between the three control points. Each of the control points offers its own set of challenges and opportunities:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/55bdd2208cc79e3c5edadf8444d8314917841938.jpg[/img]
[b]▶ A Flag Control Point Area[/b] 
This point is the closest to where the round begins, and it’s an open space, so be prepared for early rushes. The [b]Boost Jump[/b] mechanic can be used here to gain aerial dominance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/ec2000bef2c37dff4530075cb0297f4bb1f1ff7d.jpg[/img]
[b]▶ B Flag Control Point Area[/b] 
A bit farther out, B is the key to controlling the map. It’s designed for sniper battles and close-quarters combat, with a sniper’s line of sight leading to the control point.

notes.title: New Tactical Tools: Special Weapons Now Available!
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

Special Weapons are now available in AVA Global, added through the May Update!

[h1]What Are Special Weapons?[/h1]
Special weapons in AVA Global are unique armaments that provide tactical advantages beyond conventional firearms, [b]enabling strategic gameplay opportunities.[/b] These specialized pieces of equipment are equipped in a [b]dedicated special weapon slot,[/b] separate from standard weapon slots, with [b]different types available for each class.[/b]

[h1]Special Weapons Types & Features[/h1]

[h3]1. Healing Pistol[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/517617f4825c8f1f2404760f6f0f3cc3974d5009.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Class[/b]: [u]Pointman[/u]
[*] [b]Description[/b]: A medical pistol that fires adrenaline-filled capsules to restore health.
[*] [b]Function[/b]: Restores HP to allies who have lost combat effectiveness due to low health.
[*] [b]Key Features[/b]:
 - Restores a set amount of depleted HP when hitting allies
 - Deals damage to enemies, similar to a standard secondary weapon
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/775c912f1fed8b5b0fc5d727da29b4cbab92b98f.png[/img]

[h3]2. EMP Grenade[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/80b07bab79a3c4a870f7b8ebe37c403e47aba3ca.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Class[/b]: [u]Rifleman[/u]
[*] [b]Description[/b]: A throwable weapon that emits gamma rays upon detonation, affecting all electronic devices in its radius.
[*] [b]Function[/b]: Significantly reduces enemy accuracy for a limited duration when hit by the electromagnetic pulse.
[*] [b]Key Features[/b]:
- Temporarily disables weapon scope and zoom functions
- Prevents the use of binoculars during the EMP effect
- Deactivates night vision mode and drains the battery
- Hides crosshair display and lowers weapon accuracy during EMP effect
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/880a2b788520110281a04dcef1e9f294827bac24.png[/img]

[h3]3. Lightbulb[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/27be24832ba5a0872c691f011400f1342e7faa42.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Class[/b]: [u]Sniper[/u]
[*] [b]Description[/b]: A throwable device with significant impact when activated:
[*] [b]Key Features[/b]:
- Creates glass fragments on the ground that make enemies' footsteps audible, even when they are walking
- Deals damage to enemies when hit
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/ec08d33c09bd9eb655a1f5ac171937a2af1e3a63.png[/img]
[i][u][b]※ Note: The Lightbulb weapon is currently under development, and some features may be subject to change.[/b][/u][/i]

[h3]Where to Purchase?[/h3]
Shop → Hot & NEW
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/ab0eca481bd5994ae84a557024d1558271d7da4e.png[/img]
[u][b]※ Please note that each special weapon is purchasable only once at the in-game shop and is available for purchase for a limited period of 15 days.[/b][/u]

[h3]How to Equip?[/h3]
- Inventory → Special Weapons
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/04a16e4ac85ca2d6f81fd03044f6f9106be5e0c3.png[/img]

[h3]Quick Access[/h3]
You can  use Special Weapons quickly by pressing Shortcut[b] Key 6.[/b]

Sincerely,
Your AVA Operations Team

notes.title: Introducing Special Weapons to AVA Global
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

Special Weapons will be introduced in AVA Global through the upcoming May Update!
Before the update drops, here’s a sneak peek at these new tactical tools that will take your gameplay to the next level.

[h1]What Are Special Weapons?[/h1]
Special weapons in AVA Global are unique armaments that provide tactical advantages beyond conventional firearms, enabling strategic gameplay opportunities. These specialized pieces of equipment are equipped in a dedicated special weapon slot, separate from standard weapon slots, with different types available for each class.

[h1]Special Weapons Types & Features[/h1]

[h3]1. Healing Pistol[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/517617f4825c8f1f2404760f6f0f3cc3974d5009.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Class[/b]: [u]Pointman[/u]
[*] [b]Description[/b]: A medical pistol that fires adrenaline-filled capsules to restore health.
[*] [b]Function[/b]: Restores HP to allies who have lost combat effectiveness due to low health.
[*] [b]Key Features[/b]:
 - Restores a set amount of depleted HP when hitting allies
 - Deals damage to enemies, similar to a standard secondary weapon
[/list]
[h3]2. EMP Grenade[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/80b07bab79a3c4a870f7b8ebe37c403e47aba3ca.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Class[/b]: [u]Rifleman[/u]
[*] [b]Description[/b]: A throwable weapon that emits gamma rays upon detonation, affecting all electronic devices in its radius.
[*] [b]Function[/b]: Significantly reduces enemy accuracy for a limited duration when hit by the electromagnetic pulse.
[*] [b]Key Features[/b]:
 - Temporarily disables weapon scope and zoom functions
 - Removes squad leader spotting markers and prevents the use of binoculars during the EMP effect
 - Deactivates night vision mode immediately and drains the battery
 - Hides crosshair display and lowers weapon accuracy during EMP effect
[/list]
[h3]3. Lightbulb[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/27be24832ba5a0872c691f011400f1342e7faa42.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Class[/b]: [u]Sniper[/u]
[*] [b]Description[/b]: A throwable device with significant impact when activated:
[*] [b]Key Features[/b]:
- Creates glass fragments on the ground that produce audible crunching sounds when stepped on by enemies
- Emits a flash that temporarily blinds both allies and enemies, dealing additional damage to enemies
- Slows enemy movement while giving you an advantage with direct flash effects and damage
[/list]
[i][u][b]※ Note: The Lightbulb weapon is currently under development, and some features may be subject to change.[/b][/u][/i]

Prepare to experience these exciting new special weapons and enhance your strategic gameplay in the May Update!

Sincerely,
Your AVA Operations Team

notes.title: Dev Letter: Future Hard Core Balance Direction
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/2f717e48aba24c5c2317f5862885b18c2f3debf0.png[/img]
Hello, Mercenaries.

First of all, we would like to sincerely thank you for your continued interest and support for AVA Global.

Since the December update, many of you have shared various questions as well as feedback on areas that need improvement due to the changes made to the game.

We apologize for not providing a detailed explanation of the development direction earlier. In this announcement, we will address the questions and concerns you have raised.

[h1]What is the Direction of the Hardcore Balance?[/h1]
The current balancing goal for AVA Global is to create a "hardcore" gaming environment.

Although we updated the balance based on the popular gameplay environment from 2011 to 2015 in the December update, we understand that this change might have been unexpected and challenging for some players.

To meet the expectations of our dedicated AVA fans, we are working to establish new standards and provide fresh weapon content.

[h2]1. Weapon Balance Adjustment Plan[/h2]
The current weapon performance has been adjusted based on the balance from the most popular period between 2011 and 2015.
We have completed balance adjustments for approximately 160 weapons, and we will continue to refine the balance based on player feedback.
We will regularly update the base balance and respond quickly to any issues that arise.
Our goal is to enhance the content and appeal of various weapons.

[h2]2. Introducing New Performance for Weapon Classes[/h2]
We are considering introducing new weapon tiers with expanded specifications and performance.
In addition to expanding weapon tiers, we are also exploring a crafting system that allows players to create new items through combinations.

[h1]What About the Addition of New Content?[/h1]
We have been monitoring player feedback and gameplay patterns during the ongoing Pre-Season for the new Season Level System.
Based on this data, we are working on creating a season system that players can participate in without feeling burdened, while also enhancing the overall fun of gameplay.

[h2]1. Enhancing the Season System[/h2]
Many players have requested faster level-ups during the Pre-Season. Therefore, we plan to reduce the experience points required to level up.
Additionally, we are considering the development of exclusive seasonal items to further increase the excitement of future seasons.

[h2]2. New Map Updates[/h2]
We have analyzed the most popular maps from AVA’s history and have planned a new map that will enhance the intensity and thrill of combat.
The new map is designed to be simple yet engaging, providing exciting combat experiences with various strategic variables to keep players on their toes.

In addition to these updates, we are committed to providing a more complete game environment and diverse content in the future.

We greatly appreciate your continued support, feedback, and enthusiasm.
Please look forward to our upcoming updates, and do not hesitate to share your valuable thoughts with us.

notes.title: [Update Preview] Dec. New Map Open!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0a0e8e9bbe1eed18ade2ae70fee4aa050519641a.png[/img]

Mercenaries!

In this December update, we are preparing multiple maps update!
You will experience various battlefields!

[h1]1.Escape - Last Break[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/691b28a73f2ef703f7cd83ea44756a4c511b9383.png[/img]

A new escape mode map, "The Last Break," has been added with the December update!

Unlike the other escape maps, combat in this map is simpler, but the engagement distances have been slightly extended. This feature offers players more strategic options.

With five alarm points, it might be challenging for the NRF team to defend. However, we have carefully designed the NRF base to ensure that they can effectively manage their defense.

Additionally, the map features an underground passage and three escape routes. Instead of crowding in one area, NRF players can establish defensive positions in the escape zones or at the entrances of each escape route to prevent the EU team from escaping easily.

[h2]Map Concept[/h2]
The concept for this map is inspired by a neighboring area of one of AVA's iconic maps, "Fox Hunting." The EU base in Fox Hunting serves as the escape point in The Last Break, providing a thematic connection between the two maps.

[h1]2.Reaper flow[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/4fb515ee70aa9f1cbdd03ed20dfa5c9fb76fb631.png[/img]

Knife Battle Elimination Mode: During gameplay, you may notice players becoming the Hero.

When a player becomes the Hero, they can use a special weapon called the "Dragon Crescent Blade" for 30 seconds.

If the 30 seconds expire or they are killed by another player, the Hero status will transfer to their killer or the next eligible player.

While the Hero has the advantage of using the powerful "Dragon Crescent Blade," their character's silhouette will be visible to all players, so careful strategy is essential!

We sincerely thank all players who continue to support AVA Global!

To give everyone a refreshing change of pace when taking a break from shooting, we’ve created this lighthearted knife battle map.

Though it may have some shortcomings, we hope you enjoy it and share your valuable feedback. We will actively reflect your input to make continuous improvements.

See you on the battlefield!

[u][b]*Please note that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned information may be subject to change.[/b][/u]

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Team

notes.title: September Update Note
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c9bc490c47302062e83f83837fbf34396b3ed735.png[/img]

Mercenaries!

In this September update, we will add a variety of content  like the New Arena Format, New Weapons, and the New Map.

[b]September Update Key Highlights:
-New Map Update
-New Arena Format
-New Skin Combination System items[/b]

[h1]New Map: Slim Fox[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/65a2300e65bbcedc4b23909723d1e5cfb0fe32cd.png[/img]

We are thrilled to announce the opening of a new demolition mission map that many of you have been eagerly waiting for!

The Slim Fox map is designed to integrate combat areas with the demolition points, allowing battles to occur anywhere on the map. The fast-paced action near the bomb sites intensifies the EU/NRF conflict like never before! Prepare for intense combat in every corner of the battlefield.

[h1]New Arena Format[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/237741ef44edd3331d444c76eefe094481454d8e.jpg[/img]

The Arena mode is getting a complete overhaul!

The new Arena format allows more users to participate, with greater opportunities to earn limited-time rewards. You can now gain significant rewards even with a single match. This update improves the competitive balance among all users and ensures everyone has a chance to earn rewards.

[h1]New Skin Combination System[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/ce95cf561f27e30845638dd5f607ad48c6b2a1a3.png[/img]

In this update, we’re introducing three new Unique Tier skins!
[b]Pointman Unique Skin: XG552 Autumn Deer
Rifleman Unique Skin: X1 Gran Nobility
Sniper Unique Skin: SW.338 Raid Order[/b]

The Skin Combination system allows you to consume two weapon skins to create a new one. However, please note that once the skins are combined, they won’t be returned. The skins are grouped by class—Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper—and can only be combined within the same group to obtain a new skin of the same class.

It is restricted to each group: Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper.
Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and the weapon of the same group will be obtained through a combination process.

Tiers of weapons that can be used as Combination materials are [b]"Regular," "Epic,", "Premium", and "Unique"[/b]

After the September Update, the new skin combination skins will be available.

[h1]New Weapon[/h1]
With the September update, the new weapon X1921 will be added!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/951c82bd16337f0416183f9caf4f7e4a0aad0203.png[/img]

This weapon will initially be available for purchase in the in-game store using Titanium, and later, it will also be available for purchase with Euros.

[h1]New Box Open:[/h1]
-Galactica Box: Contains 3 types Galactica Series limited skins(KT-SC Galactica, Walt-2000 Galactica, R93 Galatica), 24 types of limited skins, in-game items and euros.
-You can obtain Galactica Box through In-game Play Reward & Attendance Reward

Galaxy Box: Contains 4 types Galactica Series limited skins(T-65 Galactica, Walt-2000 Galactica, R93 Galatica, XG550 Galatica), 24 types of limited skins, in-game items.
-You can obtain Galaxy Box through In-game Shop(Euro).

[h1]Capsule Shop Update:[/h1]
Pointman, Rifleman, Sniper Capsules are available for obtaining jackpot skins with 100% obtainable system.

[h1]Bug Fix[/h1]
-FNC Golden Drill item bug fix
-MA-107 Troll Snake item bug fix
-X24 Bianca item bug fix

[u][b]*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.[/b][/u]

We hope you enjoy all the new content added through the update!

Thank you.

Sincerely,

Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: 2nd Mercevarsary Party is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d6c1cf2811df8f9a275d55b022d8ce1424dbc3f7.jpg[/img]

Key Words:
[list]
[*] [list]
[*] [*] 1. New Mode: Death Valley Classic Mode Open!
[*] [*] 2. New System: Weapon Pass Open!
[*] [*] 3. 1 Euro Anniversary Event Pass Open!
[*] [*] 4. New Limited Update Box Jackpot Chance UP!
[*] [/list]
[/list]

[h1]2nd Anniversary Greetings
[/h1]
As you already know, August 25th holds a special place in our hearts, marking the second anniversary of AVA Global. Since our launch, we've been tirelessly delivering enriching content, with much more in the pipeline. Your unwavering interest and heartfelt feedback have made our journey thus far possible.

The memories of AVA Global's debut on that remarkable day still resonate with us, igniting our passion. However, beyond this significant milestone, we're excited to unveil what lies ahead in the coming years!

[h1]New Modes: Death Valley Classic Mode Open!
[/h1]
To celebrate our 2nd anniversary, we are introducing a new mode: [b]Death Valley Classic.[/b] Death Valley has been a highly anticipated mode for quite some time now, and we're thrilled to finally be able to bring it to you after meticulous development, ensuring seamless integration into the AVA global experience.

Death Valley places teamwork at its core, promising a captivating and engaging experience. 

This fresh mode comes with a [b]unique hidden reward [/b]distinct from our existing Death Valley 2 pocket rewards. Stay tuned!

[h1]New System: 1 Euro Anniversary Pass & Weapon Pass System
[/h1]
For this 2nd Anniversary, a new limited event pass will be opened. We've prepared a unique 2nd Anniversary Event Pass[b](1 Euro Only!)[/b] for all users.

Plus, we're attentive to your feedback, and in response to the observations made about the New System: Weapon Pass system in the August Update. These refinements will expedite the acquisition of exclusive skins, as we persistently strive to enhance your gaming journey.

Furthermore, our commitment extends to other in-game enhancements. Stay tuned for more details in our upcoming announcements.

[h1]Sneak Peek: August Update Skin Preview
[/h1]
Recent patches have unveiled exciting new weaponry like the GA-28, paired with exceptional skins to complement them. The upcoming August update keeps this tradition alive.

As we approach the update, we're delighted to offer a glimpse into the array of new amazing skins awaiting you. 

[h1]New Limited Box Pre-Reservation Event
[/h1]
Furthermore, we prepared an event for you to get the ‘New Update Box’ at the earliest after the August update with[b] Jackpot chances UP!:[/b] Login A.V.A Global every day for a limited time before the update, and receive the ‘New Update Box’ x [the number of days you logged in].

[b][Event Schedule][/b]
Universal Time(UTC): August 21st, 2022, 09:00 AM ~ August 26th, 2022, 13:00 PM

[b]Event Description:[/b]
MISSION: Log in to A.V.A Global every day for a limited time
REWARD: New Update Box *5EA
Hidden Mission: If you fulfill 6 days of log-in, you will receive another 10 New Boxes.
*All rewards will be sent within 3 business days after the event concludes.

Come to A.V.A Global on the last days before the August update, and don’t miss the chance to get the ‘New Update Box’ the fastest!
[u][b]*Please note that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned information may be subject to change.[/b][/u]

Thank you.

Sincerely

A.V.A Global Operation Team

notes.title: April Skin Combination Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/5ac0ee58365d617e0a9303de9e03dd372a2a4444.png[/img]

Mercenaries!

"Skin Combination" is a mechanic of consuming two weapon skins to obtain a new weapon skin.

It is restricted to each group: Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper.
Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and the weapon of the same group will be obtained through a combination process.

Tiers of weapons that can be used as Combination materials are [b]"Regular," "Epic,", "Premium", and "Unique".[/b]

After the April Update, the new skin combination rule will be available in the Pointman&Rifleman&Sniper Skins Combination System.

We prepared a new rule for Pointman&Rifleman&Sniper skins to make users use the specific existing premium tier skin to obtain a new Unique tier skin.

[h1]Pointman Skin Combination Rule:[/h1]

[Regular + Regular]
a. Epic: Bahamut Bushman
b. Regular Skins

[Epic + Epic]
a. Premium : 870 Red Skull
b. Epic: Epic Skins
- 870 Red Skull: 25%
- Epic Skins: 75%

a. Unique Skins: 25%
b. Premium Skins: 75%

a. Unique Skins: 50%
b. Premium Skins: 50%

a. Unique Skins: 100%

notes.title: April Skin Tier Grading System Announcement!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c363e672b734bb9245660e6d7f7ef47b278ed521.png[/img]

Mercenaries!

Today, we will introduce the April update: Stage 2 of weapon balance adjustments.

In this April update, there will be a repositioning of weapons through the application of modification points per skin tier.

[h1]Key points for skin tier grading![/h1]
[list]
[*] Global in-game weapon modification content will apply to all skins!
[*] Expansion of the weapon modification feature from base weapons to unique tier skins!
[*] Expansion of ways to obtain weapon modification coupons! (Attendance rewards, Battle Pass rewards, in-game store, etc.)
[/list]

This update to weapon grading will expand the content of weapon modification coupons,
which will make weapon balance more competitive and allow for a diverse selection of weapons and a unique gameplay experience.

To ensure all users thoroughly enjoy the weapon modification content, the ways to obtain modification coupons will be expanded,
and now, simply logging in to the game will allow you to acquire these coupons.

With this April update, we aim to deliver a completely new shooting experience and provide a service that raises your expectations.

Your ongoing interest, participation, and valuable feedback are greatly appreciated as they significantly contribute to the development of Ava Global.

We will continue to strengthen communication with you and strive to provide a better gaming experience.

[h1]Skin Combination Mega Update![/h1]
Lastly, we introduce the new unique tier skin lineup that can be obtained in the April update’s skin combination system!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/dd4b753cf6b2c70407bdb9195b21656a4fcc9549.jpg[/img]

These skins can be obtained by combining regular skins to unique skins through in-game play!

[u][b]*Please note that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned information may be subject to change[/b][/u]

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Operations Team

notes.title: Ops Team Letter: A.V.A Global Care Package Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/5251c5a7507635fce97168a0eef78d70df0700a4.png[/img]

Mercenaries! 

Thank you for your enthusiastic interest and support following our last major weapon update.

With this weapon update, you now have access to a wider variety of weapons, and the upcoming April update will introduce skin grading and more benefits for all users after the April update.

[h1]A.V.A Global Care Package:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Enhanced Rewards for New Users
[*] Expanded Distribution of Weapon Mod Tickets
[*] New Premium Box Reorganization
[*] Skin Combination System Reorganization
[/list]

[h2]Enhanced Rewards for New Users[/h2]
First, we plan to enhance rewards for new users. 
From now on, new users will receive generous welcome rewards, including[b] three types of in-game weapon skins and a base weapon box simply by creating a character.[/b] Create your character and immediately join in the fun with your new skins!

[h2]Expanded Distribution of Weapon Mod Tickets[/h2]
Additionally, you will soon be able to [b]obtain mod ticket rewards from the battle pass and attendance rewards[/b]. 
This will provide more rewards to everyone enjoying the gun mod content with the April skin grading update. Users will be able to obtain mod tickets daily through various in-game rewards, enabling more diverse gunplay.

[h2]New Premium Box Reorganization[/h2]
We also plan to make it [b]easier and more diverse to obtain high-tier skins[/b], including brand new premium and unique tier skins. 
No longer will you have to worry about acquiring new rare skins as before. You will be able to acquire new in-game boxes through game money and mission completions!

[h2]Skin Combination System Reorganization[/h2]
Lastly, we will update the skin combination system to [b]give more users the opportunity to combine regular tier skins to obtain new unique skins[/b]. This will also utilize duplicate unique skins that have been lying dormant in your inventory, allowing you to acquire limited new unique skins. Create more diverse skins and express your own style!

We are working hard to provide a more colorful gaming experience with this update. We look forward to your continued interest and participation.

Let's enjoy a more fun game together!

*Time (UTC): 2024. 04. 17, 06:00 am ~  2024. 04. 19, 00:00 pm

If this post receives 50 comments during the event period, everyone will receive Supreme Box Titanium*5.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
A.V.A Global Operation Team

notes.title: OPS/DEV LETTER: Large-Scale Diverse Weapon Update Plan
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/eabeaf775c6747f92d71f309574ff90e20127740.jpg[/img]

Mercenaries,

AVA Global has implemented a custom channel update in February, dedicated to fostering an environment where you can fully immerse yourself in the allure of AVA Global. 
Moving forward, our focus has shifted towards enriching the unparalleled shooting experience within the game rather than altering the environment.

Today, we're excited to share our upcoming plans and insights with you.

We're gearing up for a significant operation concerning firearms, a pivotal aspect of the game. 
Our strategy involves executing a three-stage base weapon balance operation. 
With the imminent update, we'll promptly roll out the first stage to elevate the core excitement and gameplay of AVA Global.

[list]
[*] Stage 1 New Balance: Starting with an update of 50 or more weapons, followed by continuous updates with the addition of new weapons.
[*] Stage 2 Re-Balancing: Creating a new weapon ecosystem with enhanced gameplay through the repositioning of all weapons.
[*] Stage 3 Post-Balance: Strengthening balance management based on various user experiences in the newly changed environment.
[/list]

[h1]Stage 1: New Balance 
- Diversified Firearms:[/h1]
AVA Global is set to expand the arsenal of firearms available in-game, ensuring a more comprehensive reflection of your unique strategies and play styles. 
Expect over 50 new base weapons to be introduced, offering players a diverse selection to tailor their loadouts to their individual roles. 
Through in-game stores and events, we'll diversify acquisition avenues and adjust Euro sale prices to make new weapons more accessible, enriching your experience with strategic depth and gameplay enjoyment unique to AVA Global.

[h1]Stage 2: Re-Balancing 
- Strategic Weapon Repositioning:[/h1]
Following the comprehensive update of 50 base weapons, the subsequent phase will focus on strategically repositioning the new additions.
Our goal with re-balancing is to foster a more competitive and varied gameplay experience, empowering players to choose and personalize their weapons. 
We're confident this process will positively impact your gameplay.

[h1]Stage 3: Post-Balance 
- Continuous Ecosystem Management:[/h1]
After completing the initial two stages, we'll embark on ongoing balance management to further enhance the core excitement of AVA Global. 
Post-update, we'll meticulously analyze in-game data and fine-tune balance based on diverse user experiences, maximizing the unique shooting experience of AVA Global in the dynamically evolving environment.

This update signifies a significant stride in the growth and development of AVA Global. 
Our aim is to not only expand the core fun of the game but also ignite excitement among our players.

Your continued interest, participation, and invaluable feedback are vital in propelling AVA Global forward. 
We remain committed to fostering enhanced communication and delivering an unparalleled gaming experience.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
A.V.A Global Team

notes.title: February Update Preview
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1a998f874ae028898a9cc359d6827bb4c67bfe80.jpg[/img]

Mercenaries!

In this February update, we will add a variety of content centered around the long-awaited custom channels.

The development of custom channels is already in its final stage, and new content that will enrich the custom channels further is scheduled to be updated sequentially.

Over the past few months, A.V.A Global has conducted a massive update and has incorporated various feedback from you, including the custom channels, new season HEX, and new maps, among other elements, to be added in this update.

[h1]February Update Preview:
1. Custom Rooms[/h1]
We are very excited to share interesting development news about custom rooms, which many of you have been waiting for. We are preparing to meet your expectations and sincerely thank you for your patience.

The custom rooms, currently in the final stage of preparation, aim to provide a space carefully designed for an enhanced personalized experience.

With this February update, modes like Demolition, Annihilation, Sniper Annihilation, AI Mode, Breakthrough, and Escape are scheduled for early update, with PVE modes to follow sequentially.

Our goal is to create a dynamic and specialized environment reflecting the features you desire. Beyond this, by introducing customized rooms, we are opening new possibilities for the community.

We are thrilled about the upcoming release of user-customized channels, paving the way for tournaments and events led by Game Masters (GMs).

This additional feature is designed to introduce competition and community aspects to the platform, enabling personalized experiences and providing an environment for thrilling competitions and events.

Please stay tuned for an updated guide related to custom rooms before the update.

[h1]2. New Season: HEX(100% Medal Pay-Back!)[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/3c96f9f0766d5d7e94cce0d618cf03a622a656b4.jpg[/img]

For A.V.A Global, the Battle Pass is one of the key contents that offers users limited season skins, in-game currency, and various rewards. Based on your feedback, we have extended the Battle Pass level range and introduced a tutorial level-up system among other initiatives.

As this has been a highly anticipated update, we have received various feedback from users. Accordingly, as many have mentioned, the HEX season is scheduled to be reflected in this massive update.

To show our appreciation for your support and interest, this season will feature a special [b]"100% MEDAL PAY-BACK" activity (Exclusive)[/b].

This Battle Pass section will allow all users to obtain all modifiable HEX series primary weapons, ensuring a diverse collection of limited skins.

[h1]3. New Maps[/h1]
With this update, a variety of new maps, led by Windmill, will be coming your way.

Windmill is set to launch as a new Sniper Annihilation mode, eagerly awaited by many users, and will include additional new maps linked with custom rooms, providing a fresh and fun experience unlike anything seen in A.V.A Global before.

[h1]In Conclusion[/h1]
Since the January update, A.V.A Global has been preparing updates aimed at enhancing the unique fun of A.V.A Global gameplay.

Besides the content mentioned earlier, a skin combination system and a new skin series are also scheduled for this update, so we ask for your keen interest.

As always, we are continuously researching new ways to enhance the A.V.A Global gaming experience and are always listening to your valuable feedback on upcoming new systems and content.

Please look forward to more detailed information about our new development work through patch notes and announcements in future updates.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e73878e2452db92d34b929b80cce442785897353.jpg[/img]

Mercenaries!

"Skin Combination" is a mechanic of consuming two weapon skins to obtain a new weapon skin.

It is restricted to each group: Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper.
Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and the weapon of the same group will be obtained through a combination process.

Tiers of weapons that can be used as Combination materials are [b]"Regular," "Epic," and "Premium."[/b]

After the January Update, the new skin combination rule will be available in the Sniper Skin Combination System.
Additionally, a completely new rule will be applied to each faction, allowing users to obtain higher-tier skins with increased probabilities.
We prepared a new rule for Sniper skins to make users use the Battle Pass skin [X40A5 Valentine] to obtain a new Unique tier skin.

notes.title: DEV LETTER: AVA Global New Era! (Euro Boost 200% Open!)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/baeb41a426d9ba1517d1c8f5e9ea8d58ec00b5c0.png[/img]

Mercenaries!

First of all, we would like to express our gratitude for the tremendous support you have shown since the official release of A.V.A Global in August 2022. 
We take this opportunity to share with you the key updates scheduled for January.

[h1]New Mode[/h1]
In the upcoming January update, we are introducing the '[b]Prison Break: Escape[/b]' Co-op AI mode. 
We have been preparing various content additions that users have been eagerly anticipating since the January update. 

Please understand that due to system optimization requirements in the global environment, existing modes may not be immediately added.

The 'Prison Break: Escape' mode in this update offers non-stop enemy encounters, shooting gameplay, and the excitement of annihilating enemies and escaping the map. 
The rules of survival and escape unique to this mode will provide a thrilling experience.

[h1]New Battle Pass [/h1]
The new Battle Pass introduced in this update addresses feedback received on Battle Pass rewards, especially the high demand for free distribution of limited edition skins. 

In this Battle Pass, [u][b]both free and paid users[/b][/u] will have the opportunity to obtain limited edition skins. The theme for these skins revolves around Valentine's Day.

Additionally, [b]regular Battle Pass and Battle Pass bundle users[/b] will be able to obtain [b]high-tier skins through the skin combination system[/b].

Detailed information about the Battle Pass will be provided in future announcements.

[h1]Enhanced Skin Combination System Rules[/h1]
The skin combination system allows A.V.A Global users to upgrade regular skins to epic skins and further to higher-tier skins. 

We have made various improvements to the skin combination system based on user feedback, and the rules will be enhanced in this update.

The feedback regarding the probability increase adjustment in the skin combination system, particularly at the Epic to Premium stage, has been considered. 
The January update will include adjustments to increase the probability at this stage. 
Additionally, a completely new rule will be applied to each faction, allowing users to obtain higher-tier skins with increased probabilities.

Detailed information about the skin combination system update will be available in future announcements.

[h1]Weapon Modification Feedback [/h1]
The Weapon Mod system is one of A.V.A Global's main features, allowing users to customize firearms to create their own skins. 
In the January update, three(existing skins) premium-grade Mod weapons for each class will be added to the modification weapon list.
LIST: Super V Woodpecker, MA-74M War Machine, SW.338 Uranus

As mentioned before, we are aware of the significant impact the modification system can have on firearm balance. 
We are approaching this cautiously and will continue to analyze data and improve based on your feedback even after the update.

In conclusion, with the January update, numerous in-game features will be improved based on user feedback. 
We are considering various opinions and will share more detailed information in future announcements.

We will continue to listen to user opinions and feedback, and we look forward to your high expectations for the January update.

[u][b]*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.[/b][/u]

[h1]Euro Boost Event Open![/h1]
We're cranking up the excitement. Enjoy an impressive 200% boost in both in-game Euros. This is your chance to level up and dominate the battlefield like never before!
Event Period: January 22nd, 09:00 UTC, to January 24th, 09:00 UTC,


Thank you.

Sincerely,

Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: Ops Team honest talk: AVA Global Update Direction
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/395e7e14abd35a60c7050d32118a8c0f38662c7c.jpg[/img]

Mercenaries,

We appreciate the tremendous support and encouragement for the progress we shared on January 17th.
Through this opportunity, we want to share with you the content we have been preparing for the upcoming updates starting from January.

Thank you for the support and encouragement you've shown for the information we provided on January 17th.

Feeling that we may have kept you waiting for too long,
we want to quickly share with you the content we have been preparing for the mid to long term, starting from the January update.
[u][b](Please note that the following plans may be subject to change depending on the situation.)[/b][/u]

[h1]AVA Global Update Direction:[/h1]
[h2]STEP 1: Adding the PVE mode you asked for, reinforcing game MODE feedback[/h2]
[b]- New PVE mode:[/b]
Since the launch of AVA Global, users have been requesting the release of various PVE modes.
In response to this feedback, we have introduced a variety of modes such as AVA Train, Death Valley, and Overrider.
While many users have enjoyed these modes, we have received numerous requests for improvements to these mode updates.
We are currently working on preparations to introduce a new PVE mode as quickly as possible,
and we hope to share the news of the mode update with you through the January update.
(Hint: P.B.)

[b]Reinforcement of Weapon MOD System feedback:[/b]
Alongside this, there will be a revision to the Weapon MOD system.
As there have been opinions that the current effects are unclear, the system will be revised to provide clear feedback.
Additionally, to help users find their preferred firearm style with various specs,
we are planning to distribute Weapon MOD Tickets abundantly.

Furthermore, recognizing that the firearm Weapon MOD system is not limited to new skins, and in consideration of the value preservation of existing skins,
each branch will add one existing weapon to its list in the January update.

We are aware that the modification system can have a significant impact on firearm balance, so we are approaching it with caution,
and detailed information will be provided in the upcoming January update announcement!

[h2]STEP 2: Sharing the development status of Custom Rooms.[/h2]
We are preparing the creation of custom rooms, which received the highest percentage of feedback from you.
In order to provide a more stable environment, we are currently accelerating development with the goal of reflecting it in the February 2024 update.

We are excited as the day approaches when we can finally introduce custom rooms to you.
We will do our best to ensure you can enjoy custom rooms stably.

[h2]STEP 3: Weapon rebalancing[/h2]

In A.V.A Global, '[b]Unique weapon recoil pattern[/b]' is a key element that allows you to experience the unique fun of AVA Global.
Among the feedback, the most mentioned aspects were (1) firearm balance and (2) various base firearms.

Therefore, we are contemplating a comprehensive overhaul to balance existing versions and maximize the fun at the current stage.
We plan to revamp it in a direction where you can utilize a variety of weapons according to your play style in the mid to long term.

In the process of setting this direction, we will continuously share intermediate situations with you.
We will carefully consider and proceed with the rebalancing based on your valuable feedback.

In addition, we are preparing to introduce even more diverse new content,
and we will continue to communicate with you and build together in the future.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operation Team

notes.title: Ops Team honest talk: Feedback, Balance, and News
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e2fd59341aefb27d3047eb39a9ff307ba48814d5.png[/img]
Mercenaries,

In A.V.A Global, exciting developments continue to unfold, and we are pleased to share the progress with you. 
Thank you for providing various opinions related to the Weapon Modification System. 
Your feedback is highly valued, and the operations/development team actively considers it for fair gameplay.

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
We recognize that many of you prioritize game balance. AVA had plans for character specialization as part of the direction for game improvement. 
Adjustments, including HP increases, were made considering future updates and balance, but due to unfavorable player experiences, a quick rollback(of -20hp) was decided.
We are currently in careful discussions about the balance direction, aggregating opinions from users such as "one-shot headshot" and "classic model adjustments." 
We aim to improve in the optimal direction by listening to your opinions, not just the thoughts of the AVA team. Please bear with us a little longer.

[h3]Feedback Implementation:
[/h3]Firstly, we anticipate being able to share good news with you soon. 
We are preparing the most-requested feature, custom room creation, and appreciate your patience for the slight delay in ensuring a stable environment. 
We are also carefully reviewing modes to be included in custom rooms and welcome your input.

[h3]Modification System:
[/h3]Aware of the significant impact the modification system can have on gun balance, we approached it cautiously. 
Initially, the system was designed to minimize the impact on individual gun modifications. 
We are now preparing to provide clearer feedback on the system's effects, addressing the unclear aspects based on continuous data analysis and user feedback.

[h3]Game play Rewards:
[/h3]Feedback regarding a shortage of in-game currency, Euro, hindering the utilization of the special store content, has been acknowledged. 
To address this, we introduced the new "Euro Box" to increase the Euro amount obtainable after each game. 
The Euro Box is now part of daily quests and includes a variety of premium items in the Supreme Box (Titanium, Euro), excluding AVA BOX and Premium BOX. 
This allows you to choose rewards according to your play style, and we will swiftly apply additional opinions.

[h3]Counteraction against Unfair Practices:
[/h3]We are consistently addressing unfair practices such as illegal programs and bug exploitation. 
Through automated detection systems, reviewing reported content, and various methods, we respond robustly. 
Monthly updates on our official website inform the community of the actions taken. 
We commit to continuing strong measures against unfair users.

Ban List for Unfair Practices: https://www.avaonline.global/?mKey=1&sKey=1#board/list/892/N

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operation Team

notes.title: December Update Developer Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c337b8f3f1bcc7e18569e0b99b7b5d517c334e0e.png[/img]
Mercenaries!

One of the most important aspects at A.V.A Global is the shooting play. Utilizing various weapons in-game to navigate the battlefield and progressing through gameplay with suitable strategies for each battlefield is a crucial element at A.V.A Global. Over the next few months, A.V.A Global is planning extensive updates to provide you with a more enjoyable gaming environment. Today, we will share updates regarding these plans and upcoming patches.

[h1]December Update Preview:[/h1]

[h2]Battle Pass Renewal:[/h2]
The Battle Pass at A.V.A Global is a major content where many users can obtain diverse rewards such as limited-season skins and in-game currency. Based on user feedback, we have attempted various changes, including extending Battle Pass level ranges and introducing a tutorial level-up system.

However, many users mentioned that the Battle Pass cycle is too long. Therefore, starting from this December, the Battle Pass duration will decrease to match each update period. Although the duration is shorter than the previous three months, the overall rewards will include seasonal limited skins at the same level as three update rewards. In the December Battle Pass, you can experience various "Christmas" themed skins, and it will be designed to offer a more diverse range of skins for all users during the December update. Additionally, a larger-scale change is planned for January next year, so we appreciate your participation.

[h2]New Game Maps&Modes:[/h2]
With this map update, White Out and Break Out maps will be introduced, and White Out, a new Breach mode that many users have been anticipating, will be released.

Furthermore, the newly added Break Out mode, Steal and Escape, will be a completely new and entertaining mode that you haven't experienced in A.V.A Global.
 
[h2]Daily Match System:[/h2]
Additionally, the December update will introduce the Daily Match system. Unlike Arena Match, Daily Match will offer a fast pace fun for users. While Arena is a "Hardcore" system where skilled players compete for the highest skill and top-tier rewards, Daily Match will provide a relatively lighter but compact match system. Players can earn much more rewards in a short playtime compared to the existing Quick Match rewards.

As this is the first time for this content, the December update will be conducted in a "Free Season" format. We plan to continuously improve based on your feedback.

Also, new items will be added to the "Ultimate Unique Soldier Box," which was tentatively distributed in the previous Arena. So, we ask for your interest in both Daily Match and Arena Season.

[h2]Special Shop:[/h2]
We have presented attractive skins through various capsules and boxes, and many users have provided feedback on capsule shops and in-game shops. Based on your feedback, a Special Shop with high accessibility and easy participation will be added. Through this new shop, you can obtain a more diverse range of items. Please check for details in future announcements.
 

[h1]Goals for the January 2024 Update:[/h1]
While December is focused on new attempts, January 2024 is preparing for an update in the direction of providing a unique enjoyment of A.V.A Global gameplay. Although detailed information will be revealed in the future as development is ongoing, the next update is planned to prepare A.V.A Global users to feel the core fun of A.V.A more clearly.

To achieve this, we are developing the Custom Channel and Black Market as development goals for the first quarter of 2024. A large-scale update is planned to enhance the core fun of A.V.A Global, so we ask for your interest not only in the December update but also in the content to be added in January 2024.

In conclusion...

Our ultimate goal in the development plan is to provide a better playing environment that aligns with how players enjoy the game today. As always, we will continuously research new ways to enhance the A.V.A Global gaming experience, and we always value your valuable feedback on upcoming new systems and content.

Please stay tuned for more detailed information on the new development work we have prepared through patch notes and announcements in future updates.

Thank you.
A.V.A Global Operations Team

notes.title: Skin Combination New Season (Weapon Modification System!)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/835ea0fe26264472e51967f509abaff6ee8b2f6e.png[/img]

Mercenaries!

"Skin Combination" is a mechanic of consuming two weapon skins to obtain a new weapon skin.

It is restricted to each group: Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper.
Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and the weapon of the same group will be obtained through a combination process.
Tiers of weapons that can be used as Combination materials are [b]"Regular," "Epic," and "Premium."[/b]

[h1]Skin Combination System New Season![/h1]
We've made a slight change to the system, where you can now obtain specially combined skins via this system.

Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and a tier higher (or the same) skin is obtained through the combination process.
This change will be implemented after the November Update.

Furthermore, there will be multiple ways to obtain modifiable weapons for the Weapon Modification System, and the Skin Combination System will be one of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d90a0dc10932641a3a475ff0ca66a4da3e8a05d7.png[/img]

If you proceed with the Skin Combination, you will consume a certain amount of Euros.
Weapons used as materials for Combination will NOT be returned.

[u][b]Skins Update[/b][/u] - From Skin Combination, general Unique, Premium, and Epic tier skins cannot be obtained.

However, there are [b]6 skins[/b] that can only be obtained through Skin Combination.

For example, if you combine two Epic skins, you will receive either an Epic or Premium skin.

Example: (Sniper)
[Regular + Regular]
a. Epic : Epko Panzer
b. Regular Skins

[Epic + Epic]
a. Premium : V Nagant Jager Florian
b. Epic : Epko Panzer

[Premium + Premium]
a. Unique: Ballista Chronos
b. Premium: V Nagant Jager Florian
[u][b]Note: 
>The skins(Premium and Unique tier) shown below are exclusively attainable through the skins acquired from the Skin Combination System.
>The exclusive Epic skins shown below are attainable through the Regular skins from Combination Box.[/b][/u]

Try to obtain these rare Unique skins through Skin Combination.
[u][b]*You can check the full skin list below.[/b][/u]
*Please note that items that are unobtainable as a result of skin combinations can still be used as materials.

notes.title: DEV LETTER: November Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d334bdf024405f753a633967a964b52cc61bfcce.png[/img]

Mercenaries!

As you may already know, since its launch, AVA Global has introduced various weapons and skins, a variety of PVE modes through constant updates, and new content based on what you've been telling us!

We still can't get over the day we launched AVA Global and gave our users their first taste of the game, and it's still a fantastic memory for us. That's why we've always listened to your comments and feedback, and we're always thinking about how we can make your gaming experience with AVA Global even more enjoyable.

[h1]AI Mode Launch[/h1]

With the November update, we're introducing a new mode, AI Demolition Mode, which will be available in Quick Match. AI Demolition Mode has been a highly anticipated mode for many of our users, and we're thrilled to finally bring it to you after a lot of development and adaptation to the AVA Global environment.

This AI Demolition Mode is all about the shooter aspect of the game, so it will be a lot of fun to utilize the shooting and weaponry unique to AVA Global. 

Stay tuned for more details on this new mode!

[h1]Improved Gun Content[/h1]

As everyone knows, the core content of AVA Global is gunplay & skins, and we believe that gunplay with various maps is one of the most essential parts of the AVA Global gaming experience.

That's why we've been thinking about how we can make your gaming experience with AVA Global more enjoyable.

With this update, we're introducing a new system, the Gun Modification System, which will allow you to create and play with your own guns. Of course, the Gun Modification System isn't just a gun enhancement system, it will allow you to customize your guns to suit your own playstyle. In addition, Gun Modification System-enabled guns will also be available to free-to-play users, and we will continue to improve the system through future updates.

[h1]New Balance Improvements[/h1]

We wanted every item to be an "attractive item" in-game, and we worked hard to create a game environment where users could choose from all the items and have a variety of fun.

In addition to this, we are constantly evolving the game to create a game environment where more diverse items (characters & weapons) perform better and to diversify further the routes users can take to enjoy the fun of shooting.

This requires a careful approach to ensure that the core gameplay fun of AVA Global is maintained without compromising the game experience for all AVA Global users, and we've taken into account the various balance suggestions you've provided through various channels, such as the gun modification system. Plus, [b]character HP balance rollbacks[/b] will be patched.

Of course, this isn't the end of our balancing work, as we'll continue to listen to you and actively incorporate your feedback into future updates and development.

We believe this proactive approach to communicating with you will only make AVA Global a more fun game to play. 

Last but not least, we will continue to make updates in various areas, such as item balancing and adding new modes, and we will do our best to ensure a fair and stable in-game environment. Although these tasks will not be solved with just a few patches, we will not give up.

We want everyone to have fun in AVA Global, and we hope you'll stay tuned for future growth and updates.

[u][b]*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.
[/b][/u]

Thank you.

Sincerely,

Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/a5f7ad7a68ec3b46c34b53812adaf77734c2809b.jpg[/img]

Mercenaries!

Prepare yourselves for the exciting debut of Last Man Standing Mode, the newest mode mission from AVA Global.

Last Man Standing Mode is a unique survivor mode that promises a thrilling experience for both newcomers and veterans.

Dive into the heart-pounding action reminiscent of your arcade days, where every quarter spent meant hours of non-stop fun with your neighborhood pals.

[previewyoutube=wzP5SwyyA8g;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Story Overview:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/203b41742e03840a97a593e35149ded7c42f800c.jpg[/img]

EU forces have made the decision to transport prisoners from a camp near the city of Petrozavodsk to a camp near St. Petersburg. 
For some reason, EU special operatives have infiltrated the group, disguising themselves as prisoners. As the prisoners attempt to hijack a helicopter, their plan fails, leading them to employ parachutes to escape. 
An unmapped island in the middle of Lake Ladoga in northwestern Russia. The uninhabited town in the middle of nowhere periodically sounds an alarm, each time releasing a deadly cloud of spores from an undisclosed location. 
With a limited number of survival kits, prisoners and special operatives await rescue and begin a desperate fight for survival that teeters between cooperation and betrayal.

New rewards, the Last Man Standing Mode Chain Saw, Black Nunchuks, M67, and Smoke II, will be available in the upcoming update as rewards for playing the Last Man Standing Mode.

notes.title: Cutomize Your Weapon Skin: Weapon Customization System!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/25b592723f5631e32596a2c48d906974a7499caf.png[/img]

Mercenaries!

This September update brings you a whole new system: the Weapon Customization System!

Introducing the Weapon Customization System:

The Weapon Customization System is a brand-new feature that allows players to customize the skins of their weapons. 

[h1]Customize your weapon skins to make them your own![/h1]

Before diving into Weapon Customization, let's watch the sneak peek of Weapon Effect Customization: AF-90 SAS!

[h2][b]Weapon Effect Customization: AF-90 SAS[/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=7yczhtb_IWM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]How to customize weapons:[/h1]

There are two main ways to improve your weapons:
1. Record kills and assists in quick match mode to earn EXP.
2. Use the same skin item as a material in the weapon customization menu to gain significant EXP.
[u][b]Tip: You can now use duplicate/same weapons as a source of EXP, so you can maximize your weapon EXP and Kill and assist Points efficiently![/b][/u]

[h1]List of weapons with the Weapon Customization System:[/h1]

After the September update, the Weapon Customization System will be rolled out for prioritized select weapons.

[b]TC-9 SAS[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/93810baaa84095e1c709a08af2d7a838819bb55f.png[/img]

[b]AF-90 SAS[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/51fb865d68364046d07107240264f8203afc9922.png[/img]

[b]ML SC5 SAS[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/8c6df556204c2632aa7314c2f77d8c94e92d3761.png[/img]

First, all players with the Free Battle Pass will receive 100% access to one Weapon Customization System-enabled skin.

Players who purchase the Paid Battle Pass can access three skins with the Weapon Customization System.

In addition, more released skins will be available from the existing Premium tier skins.
After the September update, two additional new skins will be released, so stay tuned.

[h1]How to apply the Weapon Customization Item:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/38da2d1e04929dffcca8dd869ada35d7f4d5c2d4.png[/img]
Note: The image is for reference only and may differ from the actual game screen.

1. When you enter the Weapon Customization menu, you'll see the weapon's level information and cosmetic item information.

Selecting each tab will list the corresponding items, and each cosmetic item will be labeled with its name and itemization. Clicking the Buy button for a cosmetic item that you have not yet purchased will make it available to spend points and use for motivation.
[u][b]Note: Once you click the Buy button, you will not be able to get your points back, so please be careful when purchasing items.[/b][/u]

2. Each weapon may have different types of customization items available for purchase. The maximum level varies depending on the types of items that can be purchased.

3. The maximum level depends on the number of Customization Effect Taps each weapon has, from a maximum level of 20 to a maximum of 50.
Users can purchase weapon customization items with the points they receive whenever they level up the weapon.
Players earn 1 point for each level increase, which can be used to purchase items.

4. All customized weapons will be labeled as "MAX" for maximum leveled weapons in your inventory, where you can see your current level and level experience gauge.
Once maxed out, all cosmetic items will be unlocked, and each weapon will have a different number of available cosmetics, as well as a different number of points required.

This is the first new weapon progression system in AVA Global, and we've put a lot of work into it. We hope you enjoy it, and if you have any suggestions, we'll be sure to take them into consideration.

[u][b]*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.
[/b][/u]

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operation Team

notes.title: A.V.A Global Death Valley Mode - The Mission Has Gone to Hell!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/66ac039953cc0939e25dd7ab9212423ae71b4c7d.jpg[/img]

Mercenaries!

Prepare yourselves for the exciting debut of Death Valley, the newest scenario mission from AVA Global.

Death Valley is a co-op mode that promises a thrilling experience for both newcomers and veterans. 

Dive into the heart-pounding action reminiscent of your arcade days, where every quarter spent meant hours of non-stop fun with your neighborhood pals.

[h2]Story Overview:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/f79e62ac09106159ebb4f891ee4b7295a3e89ced.jpg[/img]

After the end of the European War in April 2011, the arrests and trials of war criminals from the old NRF were underway. Various plots and schemes that took place under the NRF regime were beginning to come to light.

Pavel, a commander of the NRF's Interior Ministry Special Forces and a suspected war criminal, was allegedly responsible for the Chernivtsi incident. In this incident, NRF soldiers infected with residual chemical weapons leaked from an abandoned NRF biological weapons research facility developed psychotic symptoms and rioted.

EU intelligence agencies tracking Colonel Pavel Panfilov received information that he may have been the leader of the militants who took over the small island of Warbal in the Kai Islands, on the border between Indonesia and Papua New Guinea, two years ago.

Colonel Panfilov, who led the development of a special biochemical weapon that awakened only human ferocity and combat instincts, escaped the NRF after the war with only a handful of his men, along with his research and data. He then traveled to Southeast Asia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/fe8e89161a26735572040dfeb563d3c952bbc03a.jpg[/img]

After capturing the island of Warbal, which he had been eyeing for some time, Colonel Panfilov built a massive facility to smelt underground zinc ore for its byproduct, indium. He used the profits from the smuggling of indium to fortify the island. He then used his research to form a band of pirates, who used their beefed-up soldiers to blockade the surrounding sea lanes and demand exorbitant tolls.

Determined to eliminate the growing threat posed by Colonel Panfilov, EU intelligence planned the disintegration of the group through the elimination of Panfilov, who led the organization with powerful charisma and dictatorship. They sent special forces to do so.

[h2]Death Valley Rewards:[/h2]

Two new rewards, the[u][b] Death Row Mask and Mad Galil Survivor[/b][/u], will be available in the upcoming update as rewards for playing the Death Valley Mode.

Brace yourself for an added challenge as the August update introduces two escalating difficulty levels, offering enhanced rewards as you brave the tougher settings. Once Death Valley is live, anticipate a series of engaging events designed to help you secure these exclusive items.

[Mad Galil Survivor]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/14fbb32d734c8c6d4e0521cab452d1296c9265cc.png[/img]

[Death Row Mask]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/17fe3f2516ccdab2e811e71aab2c7f90b038f0a3.png[/img]


[h2]Journey Through Each Stage of Death Valley:[/h2]

Boat: After clearing out the enemies in the cave, you will arrive at the dock and find your boat ready to go. Use the Engine [E] key on the instrument panel to start the boat and it will take off.
Tip: As soon as you start the boat, you will be swarmed by fast prisoners from the back of the boat, so be prepared to react quickly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c9941e2052647c5bb488e32761c20cf836c5efaa.png[/img]

Bridge section: The moving boat will stop in front of a wooden bridge. To destroy the bridge, you need to remove the explosive drums indicated by the arrows. The bridge must be removed in two stages: first and second.
Tip: Make sure to remove all of the explosive drums before destroying the bridge. This will make it easier to destroy the bridge and avoid taking damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0cc3bc920a4446a43d7083c6aa15bcfc0ae45fcb.png[/img]

Tunnel section: You must navigate through the tunnel while avoiding the walls, prisoners, and UAVs attacking from above.
Tip: Use the space on either side of the boat to avoid the UAVs and target enemies. You can also destroy the launchers to prevent the UAVs from spawning.

Gatekeeper: This is the final section of Round 1 and the passage to Round 2. A drum-throwing mob awaits you here, guarding the gate.
Tip: This mob has high health, so use the Health Packs and AmoPacks on the boat to defeat it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/da8536ec0f60066d1606846da4c79efbd38a4d17.png[/img]

Lift Section: At the start of Round 2, after clearing out the remnants, players will find a broken passageway. Players will need to use the repeatedly reciprocating lifts to cross the bridge and eliminate the Drum Throwing Mob and a number of Prisoners.
Tip: Enemies on the other side will continue to spawn unless the player crosses the lift, so be aggressive and take them out quickly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/90619f53a93b10a58492a9a61b7ca4736d02916a.png[/img]

Ball Drop: A giant ball-shaped byproduct with a specific pattern will roll toward you, and you will need to avoid it to advance. In the secondary ball drop, two balls will roll in a specific pattern and mobs waiting at the top will block your progress.
Tip: Read the pattern of the balls and use the intervening dodge spots to advance. You can also use grenades to take out the enemies on top.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e726d01235a153eb5f2f49f93c6a31dedca17495.jpg[/img]

Automatic gate section: There are three automatic gates in total, and you will need to eliminate the large amount of enemies waiting for you.
Tip: There are several different types of mobs here, so be prepared to use a variety of weapons and strategies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/55831d565d4b161d5f842896a70f24068a012e8d.png[/img]

Chopper Section: The final boss of Round 2, the Chopper threatens you with its incredible health and missile attacks. You will need to use RPGs scattered around the ground to shoot it down.
Tip: This section requires a bit of teamwork, so work with your teammates to take down the Chopper quickly.

UAV 1: This is the early part of Round 3, where you will need to dodge UAV fire and destroy the multiple UAV launchers set up in front of you.
Tip: It's important to focus on each launch pad rather than spreading out. This will help you take down the UAVs more quickly.

UAV Section 2: Destroy the UAV launchers that open doors at regular intervals and take out multiple mobs. You can only clear this section by destroying all the UAV launchers.
Tip: This is a time-consuming section where teamwork between players is very important. Work together to destroy the launchers quickly and take out the mobs that appear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/32868964b9cf846bc1e6138db26b405b60c29be3.png[/img]

Boss Area: The final boss area gives you a chance to regroup and admire the rainbow waterfall before entering. This is the final section of the Death Valley map where players will need to be vengeful and tough, and it's also the final way out after the boss is defeated.
Tip: There are no special tips, just teamwork, and skill to defeat the boss and eventually escape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/3605107b14f4b9d0973685296d04a0d9b6634d18.png[/img]

We're thrilled to present Death Valley, a mode long-awaited by our community. Your support and enjoyment are invaluable to us as we continue to craft exceptional gaming experiences. Brace yourselves for the thrill of Death Valley – we can't wait for you to immerse yourselves in the action!

[u][b]*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.
[/b][/u]

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operation Team

notes.title: 3ON3 Mode: Elite Team Match Play!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1f5bcd73ef5561f1eee2bb67161826f65e4d9d2f.jpg[/img]

Mercenaries!

In the upcoming August update, a fresh and exciting mode, "3ON3," will be open in A.V.A Global.

While our expansive collection of maps has included thrilling 5v5 and 8v8 battles, "3ON3" marks the arrival of a small-scale combat experience, offering a new dimension of engagement.

This mode represents a significant milestone for AVA Global, unveiling the first-ever addition to our array of game modes.

[h2]3ON3 Mode:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/5842ab4f3062bcb620d69b1e68779d283fc644c4.jpg[/img]

"3ON3" Mode takes advantage of the three distinct classes within AVA Global to create fast-paced, small-scale skirmishes. This mode allows three elite operatives to collaborate and unleash their strategic prowess in a dynamic and frenetic battlefield environment.

A departure from traditional strategic gameplay, "3ON3" Mode demands swift thinking and adaptability, as players must react promptly to evolving circumstances. This mode brings a fresh breeze of competitive action to our gaming landscape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/dd697ab16938bfd790ba013551424353a8193ed0.jpg[/img]

[h2]3ON3 Mode Rewards:[/h2]

We're excited to introduce a unique achievement reward system exclusively for "3ON3" Mode. Players will be rewarded with an A.V.A Box for winning, available with repeated rewards.

Please mark your calendars for our special one-year anniversary update in August, when we'll unveil the Victory Badge achievement reward system. Collect Victory Badges in 3on3 mode to unlock a variety of exciting rewards:

Earn 5 Victory Badges in 3on3 mode to get  [b]Premium Box*1[/b]
Earn 25 Victory Badges in 3on3 mode to get [b]Unique Soldier Box*1[/b]
Earn 50 Victory Badges in 3on3 mode to get [b]Unique Soldier Box*5[/b]
*Please note that Victory Badge rewards are based on your total number of 3on3 mode victory badges earned and can only be claimed once.

[h2]3ON3 Mode Rules:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e55f0d579d47a89bcc3d5c50dd88afd40c44c7be.jpg[/img]

In the new 3v3 mode, teams will compete in a series of 19 rounds, with the first team to reach 10 wins being declared the winner. The first round will be a pistol showdown, with each player selecting from one of the three available classes. If a player does not select a class, they can either collaborate with the other players who did not choose or randomly select a class.

If the score is tied at 9-9, the Deuce Rule will come into play. Under the Deuce Rule, the first team to win two consecutive rounds will be declared the winner. The Deuce Rule can only be applied for a maximum of 20 rounds.

We are excited to introduce the 3v3 mode, our first foray into small-scale battles. We believe this mode will offer a unique and challenging experience for our players. We hope you enjoy it!

We value your feedback and will use it to shape the future of the 3v3 mode.

Once again, we appreciate your continued support of AVA Global

[u][b]*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.
[/b][/u]

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operation Team

notes.title: A.V.A Global Dev Letter August
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/6813222167f296dcb1f7b901a3e4ea07f04f36bb.png[/img]

Mercenaries!

Exciting news, everyone! Get ready for a thrilling new update to our beloved game! Our team has been working tirelessly over the past few months to bring you an even better gameplay experience, packed with thrilling new features and enhanced gameplay.

[h1]1 Year Anniversary Greetings[/h1]

As you're already aware, August 25th holds a special place in our hearts, marking the one-year anniversary of Ava Global. Since our launch last year, we've been tirelessly delivering enriching content, with much more in the pipeline. Our journey thus far has been made possible by your unwavering interest and heartfelt feedback.

The memories of AVA's global debut on that remarkable day still resonate with us, igniting our passion. However, beyond this significant milestone, we're excited to unveil what lies ahead in the coming years!

[h1]New Modes: 4-player CO-OP Death Valley & Elite Squad Play 3on3[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/fe8e89161a26735572040dfeb563d3c952bbc03a.jpg[/img]

To celebrate our one-year anniversary, we are introducing two new modes: Death Valley and 3on3. Death Valley has been a highly anticipated mode for quite some time now, and we're thrilled to finally be able to bring it to you after meticulous development, ensuring seamless integration into the AVA global experience.

Death Valley places teamwork at its core, promising a captivating and engaging experience. On the other hand, the 3on3 mode is a small-scale combat that offers a thrilling, fast-paced experience, unlike any other modes you've seen in AVA Global before.

Both of these fresh modes come with unique rewards distinct from our existing pocket rewards. Stay tuned for more comprehensive details coming your way next week!

[h1]Enhanced Skin Combination System[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d90a0dc10932641a3a475ff0ca66a4da3e8a05d7.png[/img]

We're attentive to your feedback, and in response to the observations made about the skin combination system in the July patch, we're rolling out improvements in the August update. These refinements will expedite the acquisition of exclusive skins, as we persistently strive to enhance your gaming journey.

Furthermore, our commitment extends to other in-game enhancements, such as refining the on/off functionality of in-game effects. Stay tuned for more details in our upcoming announcements.

[h1]Sneak Peek: August Update Skin Preview[/h1]

Recent patches have unveiled exciting new weaponry like the SW.338 and Z3A3, paired with exceptional skins to complement them. The upcoming August update keeps this tradition alive.

As we approach the update, we're delighted to offer a glimpse into the array of new amazing skins awaiting you. 

[b][New Skin List]:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/a0706e9970702f071551287eded746e311feaffa.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/2b0fdce25ee91e97337b61f31e6b3176a204cabe.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/9e7807155b72ac16f892757d9745d40966dfb17c.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to enjoy all the new content coming your way!
Which content do you expect? Tell us in the comment!

[u][b]*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.
[/b][/u]

Thank you.

Sincerely,

Your AVA Global Operations Team
