notes.title: NEW MODE: INFILTRATION - FALCON
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/327d47a717e3518d2251bf314b6e5e32e68874f8.png[/img]

Mercenaries!

Are you ready for a new experience? 
Today, we are thrilled to unveil Infiltration Mode, a groundbreaking game mode that goes beyond the boundaries of traditional Battle Royale. Prepare yourself for strategic team battles on A.V.A Global's brand-[b]new map - FALCON![/b]

In Infiltration Mode, we're introducing a completely fresh approach to enjoying A.V.A Global, offering you a truly unique and immersive experience.

[h1]Mission Overview[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/4fa86e0b7387ff5e61e35855992acc7e9fefa8fd.jpg[/img]

[h2]Mission Type: Round Operation - Infiltration: Falcon[/h2]
The U.S. Department of Defense gets informed of militant activity in Alaska by Canada's 401st Aviation Brigade. 

As the NRF departs their camouflaged base in Kakona, the US military realizes that a month had passed since Operation Battle Defense (Brooklyn Bridge). 

They immediately mobilize their forces and evacuate to Bulduer Island, Alaska, along with the remaining EU soldiers.

As soon as the battle begins, EU soldiers must infiltrate the stronghold and hack into one of the control devices at each location to disable the radar. 

[h1]Match Info[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c75fb58bbe3db584e6e0d33519259ef3870fd511.jpg[/img]

In Infiltration Mode, players are divided into two teams:
- The NRF forces must stop the EU forces. 

[Winning Conditions] 
- EU: Hack one of the 2 mission objectives or eliminate the NRF forces.
- NRF: Prevent the EU forces from hacking the control unit, or eliminate the EU forces.

[h1]Falcon mode only features:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/66ae8581390dd9c5e2a51e84fab5c241fbfef618.jpg[/img]

The Infiltration mode introduces various elements, including destructible objects like iron plates, wood, glass, doors, fire extinguishers, and more. These objects can be utilized to change your route and employ disruptive tactics, leading to diverse gameplay experiences.

Additionally, the NRF team will receive several seconds of automatic reconnaissance when they leave the building at the beginning of battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/797bdb980d9d3bd25671f009769602bca8762279.jpg[/img]

We have created a night version of the mode to enhance the feeling of an Infiltration Operation. By adapting the visuals to match the night setting, we have focused on creating a compelling atmosphere while ensuring optimal visibility.

This mode brings a refreshing change of pace from the traditional Demolition mode, and we encourage you to experiment with different strategies and discover your own must-win strategies.

We hope you enjoy the new Infiltration mode!

[u][b]*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.
[/b][/u]

Thank you.

Sincerely,

Your AVA Global Operation Team

notes.title: A.V.A Global - Dev Letter July
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/f29f8482caede80ffc75ab2a39c265c9495a1814.png[/img]

Mercenaries!

Exciting news, everyone! Get ready for a thrilling new update to our beloved game! Our team has been working tirelessly over the past few months to bring you an even better gameplay experience, packed with thrilling new features and enhanced gameplay.

Prepare yourself for a sneak peek at what's to come: a brand-new game mode, breathtaking skins, innovative new systems, and so much more! We can't wait to share all the exciting details with you, so stay tuned for the big reveal.

[h1]New Mode: Inflitration[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0a39de50ae9f8b6862a08ec50ff7d95b1737e31d.png[/img]

Get ready for a new game mode that steps beyond traditional Battle. In this mode, the offensive team is an operation to infiltrate the enemy's camp and hack into major facilities, and the defense team aims to prevent it. 
It will give you a new way to enjoy A.V.A Global so get ready for a truly unique experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/f6652e1e9f8d117825764e8894d4211c6cb2d48a.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned for more details on this exciting new mode before the next patch, and get ready to blow away the competition with the new Infiltration Mode!

[h1]New Box System:[/h1]

At A.V.A Global, we have been introducing special boxes containing unique skins to the in-game store with every update. We have received valuable feedback from many users regarding these box products, and in the upcoming July patch, we are excited to unveil a new type of box that will be available in the in-game store. This new box will feature a hybrid format combining a [b]"package + box"[/b] structure.

With the new box, you will have the opportunity to [b]acquire a specific number of limited special boxes[/b], and plus, you will be[b] guaranteed to obtain either a Jackpot skin or a premium tier skin[/b]. This ensures that when you open this hybrid box, you will receive at least one of these highly desirable items.

In summary, this new boxed offering will provide you with a unique experience and a 100% chance to win either a Jackpot Skin or a Premium Skin. 
We encourage you to stay tuned for more information regarding this exciting announcement, which will be shared next week.

[h1]Launch of the Arena Starter Pack[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d14c9108200b2891e35d6c19a227c771effe1bc2.png[/img]

Arena mode is a ranked game mode where players can showcase their true skills. By participating in this mode, players can earn special rewards. Alongside the ongoing Arena Season 10, the Clan Mark War is also taking place. 

Arena mode is available exclusively to Arena Plus members, who enjoy various rewards and benefits. However, we have taken into consideration the feedback we received from our users regarding Arena membership. In order to encourage more players to participate in Arena while ensuring a guaranteed and fair gaming environment, we will be introducing the Arena Starter Pack. Further details will be announced in the future, but we are designing the packages to be "stackable" with the existing Arena Plus membership benefits, allowing current members to also enjoy the new pack's advantages. We appreciate your continued support and enthusiasm.

[h1]Combination System Improvements[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d90a0dc10932641a3a475ff0ca66a4da3e8a05d7.png[/img]
In the June update, Ava Global introduced two exciting additions: the Content Roulette system and the Skin Combination system. We are delighted to see that many users have enjoyed these new features, and we would like to express our sincere appreciation for all the valuable feedback you have provided us.

To further enrich your experience with the new content, we have diligently worked on implementing several enhancements that will be included in the upcoming July patch. These improvements aim to provide you with an even more enjoyable and satisfying gameplay experience.

Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to enjoy all the new content coming your way!

[u][b]*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.
[/b][/u]

Thank you.

Sincerely,

Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: Skin Combination System New Season Anouncement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/48ec670659976f188934a8b7f4de0920a91617bc.jpg[/img]

Mercenaries!

"Skin Combination" is a mechanic of consuming two weapon skins to obtain a new weapon skin.

It is restricted to each group: Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper.
Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and the weapon of the same group will be obtained through a combination process.
Tiers of weapons that can be used as Combination materials are [b]"Regular," "Epic," and "Premium."[/b]

[h1]Skin Combination System New Season![/h1]
We've made a slight change to the system where you can now obtain combined skins via this system.

Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and a tier higher (or the same) skin is obtained through the combination process.

After the Season 4 update, A.V.A Global Skin Combination System will have a new skin combination process.

The A.V.A Global Skin Combination System has been updated with a new skin combination process. Now, you can combine two weapons from the same group to obtain [b]a tier higher (or the same) skin.[/b]

The new skin combination process will be available after the Season 4 update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d90a0dc10932641a3a475ff0ca66a4da3e8a05d7.png[/img]

If you proceed with the Skin Combination, you will consume a certain amount of Euros.
Weapons used as materials for Combination will NOT be returned.

[u][b]Exclusive Skins Update[/b][/u] - From Skin Combination, general Unique, Premium, and Epic tier skins cannot be obtained.

However, there are exclusive [b]9 skins[/b] that can only be obtained through Skin Combination.

For example, if you combine two Epic skins, you will receive either an Epic or Premium skin.

Example: (Sniper)
[Regular + Regular]
a. Epic : Epko Panzer
b. Regular Skins

[Epic + Epic]
a. Premium : V Nagant Jager Florian
b. Epic : Epko Panzer

[Premium + Premium]
a. Unique: SW.338 Silver Scout
b. Premium: V Nagant Jager Florian
[u][b]Note: 
>The exclusive skins(Premium and Unique tier) shown below are exclusively attainable through the skins acquired from the Skin Combination System.
>The exclusive Epic skins shown below are attainable through the Regular skins from Premium Box.[/b][/u]

Try to obtain these rare Unique skins through Skin Combination.
[u][b]*You can check the full exclusive skin list below.[/b][/u]
*Please note that items that are unobtainable as a result of skin combinations can still be used as materials.

notes.title: A.V.A Global Roulette System
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

We are excited to introduce the[b] A.V.A Global Roulette[/b] system, a new way to earn AVA Euros. 
This is a brand-new game system that we hope will provide you with more ways to enjoy A.V.A Global.

[h1]Roulette Basic Rules:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7ee0656a5b7a9da638414e6bc61b887b35952c2d.jpg[/img]

The[b] Roulette System[/b] is a mechanic where you consume EURO to obtain more EURO by setting your goal's roulette choice with how much EURO you put in.

[list]
[*] You can choose to consume 3,000, 6,000, 9,000, 12,000, or 15,000 EURO.
[*] You can also choose to double your EURO by selecting the x2, x4, x6, x8, or x12 options.
[*] Once you have made your choices, the roulette wheel will spin and you will win if your choice matches the section that the wheel stops on.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/b48f135138231a31589134a1c501ef73671b93fe.png[/img]

[h1]What is 'JACKPOT'?[/h1]
There is a special lucky section called 'JACKPOT' in the slot. 'JACKPOT' is a special slot where users can have a chance to get a huge amount of EURO.

[list]
[*] When you start the Roulette System, the minimum amount you can bet for 'JACKPOT' is 100,000 EURO. 
[*] The 'JACKPOT' prize amount increases by 2% of the bet amount every time a user loses and does not win the 'JACKPOT'.
[/list]

[h1]Winning the 'JACKPOT'[/h1]
If you win the 'JACKPOT' slot, you will have a chance to take 'JACKPOT' EURO for a bonus!

[list]
[*] This means that you will have another chance to spin the 'JACKPOT' wheel to take the 'JACKPOT' EURO with the slot (10%, 20%, 30%, 50%, 100%).
[*] Users can [u]win up to 100 million EURO[/u].
[/list]
[u][b]*Please note that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned information may be subject to change[/b][/u]
We hope you enjoy the new A.V.A Global Roulette system. Good luck!

Thank you

A.V.A Global Operation Team

notes.title: Dev Letter - AVA Global Innovation
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/131da23edf3c9644d5754856deb8f3bc6d733aab.jpg[/img]

Mercenaries!

We’ve been working hard to improve the gameplay experience of A.V.A Global by adding new content, constantly updating the weapon balance, and many others.

Our work continues today to provide a more enjoyable experience by providing various gunplay options while maintaining realistic gunplay and core fun.

Through this announcement,  we'd like to take this opportunity to give you a [b]sneak peek[/b] of what we are preparing in the upcoming update and tell you what's new for the June update.

[h1][b]1. New Season Format[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c9479dc55264683c6ca2da94cb09218451cb051e.png[/img]

Season 4 is being prepared and is scheduled to open after the June update. 
Thank you so much for your interest and participation in Season 3 'CORE'.

For the following Season, our team is preparing a new format to introduce a variety of weapon series. 
Players will get more opportunities to get seasonal skins in Battle Pass and limited skins in the in-game shop boxes.

[h1][b]2. Clan Mark Wars[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/36a4ea8781c202f4c9263dcf29cab5b7e3f05c90.png[/img]

As you play, you face moments where you have to make various choices such as choosing your Class, Weapons, Squad, and many others which will significantly impact your match results.

Therefore, we want to diversify the range of options to provide more options to enjoy A.V.A Global.

Strategy plus teamplay is one of the most important points in A.V.A Global as well as the weapon balance. 

So, we conducted new systems to our game experience more enjoyable.
We believed that Clan Mark War system will bring a new era to skill-based users of A.V.A Global.

After the June update, we will continuously improve Clan Mark Wars for future updates and development directions.

[h1][b]3. New Cloud Service - Geforce Now[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/9bfcf566e1464ebe1c25018544d80cf01a9ad65a.jpg[/img]

After Season 4 is introduced, A.V.A Global will be available to play on one of most players' favorite devices through GeForce NOW, a cloud-based game streaming service. 

NVIDIA's game streaming service allows games with a GeForce NOW account on a wide variety of systems, to play a wide selection of games without the need to download a game client, or even have a high-end gaming PC.

Sign up for GeForce NOW via the NVIDIA website, and join the fun on A.V.A Global!

[h1][b]4. New Combination System 2.0[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0c794804c91c1f0fa45ef1e7f4104e68e99e6c1a.png[/img]

The "Skin Combination" system is was a new system that was introduced to A.V.A Global for all users who wanted a variety of skins. 
We've made a slight change to the system where you can now obtain combined skins via this system.

Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and a higher tier(or same) is obtained through a combination process.

After the Season 4 update, A.V.A Global Skin Combination System will have a new skin combination process.

The combination-obtainable skins line-up will be released in the near future. So stay tuned!

We hope you are looking forward to the new season update. Make sure to share AVA Global with all of your friends!

We will continue to improve the game and provide a better experience!
[u][b]*Please note that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned information may be subject to change[/b][/u]

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: The Power of Gods - Titan Skins
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/23ea221db0b8310102875907f25309fd505d78aa.png[/img]

Mercenaries!

Titans are coming to A.V.A Global with new skins, featuring intricate designs and motifs inspired by the gods in Greek mythology.

The Titan collection also offers one of the best weapon selections available of any skin line, encompassing all of the most frequently used weapons in the game.

It features weapon skins for the MA-47, Proto, AWX, and M1903, in addition to bringing the distinctive patterns from the 12 Titans.

[b][The Titan MA-47][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/078fe79993b3324f224d7238a03607280c5ff4fd.png[/img]

The Titans were the former gods: the generation of gods preceding the Olympics. They were overthrown as part of the Greek succession myth.

[h1]The Titans will follow you into Battle[/h1]

The new skins' feature makes sure you don’t get defeated by your enemies. The Titan skins are an ode to the time of the Greek Gods.

[b][The Titan Proto][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/62b45108567e8300502a2e9d9d3bcf49e36631a0.png[/img]

All skins have a beautiful ancient myth design that you can only find in ancient myth stories.
It makes the skins become the most unique weapon skins in the game.

[b][The Titan AWX][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/69dbd432551b61004535e6b6ec52584e7f31f0f1.png[/img]

The Titan MA-47 is topped with a totem-like animal head, further adding to the overall mystique of the set.

The Titan Proto, The Titan AWX, and The Titan M1903 are having a special pattern from Greek Mythology.

[b][The Titan M1903][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/39c771bb9461f386a855114881480a1bf159712a.png[/img]

Where you can find it:
In-game shop > Featured > Recommended or All.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/a0cc2a864f8fc414f9f0574720c7f37a1547cd2b.png[/img]
The Titan skins are available now in the A.V.A Global in-game shop. To purchase them, simply head to the Featured tab and select the Titan collection.

You will feel the gods follow you into the battle.

Thank you.

Sincerely
A.V.A Global Operation Team

notes.title: A.V.A Global New Mode - Dominate The Time !
notes.content:
[h1]1. Introducing 'OVERRIDER'[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d274e457574b9b9a7f34b6cfba3d086ed9764da7.jpg[/img]

[h2]Story Overview:[/h2]
Overrider is a new mode in AVA Train that allows players to experience a stylish and challenging shooting experience. In Overrider, players take on the role of two secretly trained special forces soldiers who, after years of research, develop a prototype mask with the ability to slow down time and infiltrate an enemy secret base.

[h1] Trailer: "Dominate The Time"[/h1]
[previewyoutube=tbnzYwhYZfs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What is 'Overrider Skill'?[/h2]
The Overrider skill is the key to success in Overrider mode. This skill allows players to slow down time, giving them a chance to accurately target enemies and dodge incoming projectiles. The Overrider skill is especially useful when dealing with powerful enemies or when multiple enemies are attacking at once.

You'll most likely use it against faster enemies or when multiple enemies swoop in at the same time, and it can be used to track and dodge fast projectiles like RPGs and missiles.

It's also an [b]essential skill[/b] when dealing with powerful bosses (Bellona) in the final round.

[b]NOTE:[/b]
[b][u]*In particular, Overrider skill requires charging after activation.[/u][/b]
[u][b]*It is very important for players to consider the charging time in order to deal with crisis situations.[/b][/u]

[h2]Round Features:[/h2]
Three open-field rounds and an arena-style boss round (4R).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d987b065cdc56593a6749e91d4217168522dd0df.png[/img]

[h2]ROUND 1 - Electric Sheild[/h2]
Break through the electric shields of the enemy control center.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/65e9795d213043c5e1d8ce02c4339fe49ac4755e.jpg[/img]
In Round 1, players must break through the electric shields of the enemy control center. To do this, players must fend off enemies that swoop in from the open field and make their way inside the control center.

[h2]ROUND 2 - Pain Bridge[/h2]
Make your way over the enemy telecommunications room and escape to the chopper.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/fc1a295f80b6700cd0c7825134fd0114a99d1cdd.jpg[/img]
In Round 2, players must cross a broken bridge into the enemy telecommunications room and call for an escape helicopter. This round is more challenging than Round 1, as players must navigate through a variety of traps and fend off enemies that are attacking from both sides of the bridge.

[h2]ROUND 3 - Black Lift[/h2]
Defend against the enemy onslaught.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/f2a2769a2986a6a238fb8cc98e169b1f52b37c2f.jpg[/img]
In Round 3, players must defend against an enemy onslaught in a space called the "elevator." This round is the most challenging of the four, as players must fend off different types of enemy attacks in specific locations.

[h2]ROUND 4- Bellona[/h2]
Defeat the final boss, 'Bellona'
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/ca7ad34d5bc9940f5f23cacf696ed0465b9321f0.jpg[/img]
In Round 4, players must defeat the final boss, Bellona. Bellona is a powerful enemy that can deal a lot of damage. To defeat Bellona, players can use the Overrider skill to slow down time and accurately target her weak points.

[h2]5. Mode Reward[/h2]

For successfully completing Overrider mode, players will receive a random chance to obtain exclusive rewards. The rewards that players can obtain include [b]exclusive rewards[/b]: the [u][b]' OverRider Emperor Mask' and 'R.SRH OverRider'[/b][/u] in normal level.

[b]OverRider Emperor Mask[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/a29c41e94b1bc6eef17330f5bd872119693c83e2.jpg[/img]

[b]R.SRH OverRider[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d2c93550b1700b22ff3bf292553b0993ee4317a1.jpg[/img]

The likelihood of obtaining these limited items will vary based on the difficulty level, meaning that you'll receive them faster and more if you complete the mode on a higher difficulty level.

For a higher difficulty level, you will get a higher random chance to obtain [b]exclusive rewards[/b]: the [u][b]' OverRider Emperor Mask', R.SRH OverRider', ' R.SRH Storm Rider' and 'Smoke Storm Rider'[/b][/u]

[b][R.SRH Storm Rider][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/3eeed6de6ec55a9a480212f814893a5f08004903.jpg[/img]

[b][Smoke Storm Rider][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/feb0a0c63c1af356c689176ac7e2e0374626aab9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Cooperative Play[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1fcc1d7da1c5b9ed32046ce683a104109b42777f.jpg[/img]
Overrider mode can also be played in a two-player co-op. In co-op mode, players can use the Overrider skill to help each other overcome crises. This is a key element of Overrider and a cooperative skill that allows players to help each other.

*Please note that the new mode information may be subject to change.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operation Team

notes.title: Skin Combination New Unique Skins Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0473b2307bceeeaa4628c81e69ebc324b0cef3f1.png[/img]

Mercenaries!

"Skin Combination" is a mechanic of consuming two weapon skins to obtain a new weapon skin.

It is restricted to each group: Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper.
Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and the weapon of the same group will be obtained through a combination process.

Tiers of weapons that can be used as Combination materials are [b]"Regular," "Epic," and "Premium."[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0c794804c91c1f0fa45ef1e7f4104e68e99e6c1a.png[/img]

If you proceed with the Skin Combination, you will consume a certain amount of Euros.
Weapons used as materials for Combination will NOT be returned.

The tier of the Combination result depends on the tiers of materials. In general, using high-tier skins as materials increase the probability of high-tier results.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7c6ad49d312a959cce88b3ae956f34b554312a91.png[/img]

[u][b]Exclusive Unique Skin Update[/b][/u] - From Skin Combination, general Unique tier skins cannot be obtained.

However, there are exclusive Unique skins that can only be obtained through Skin Combination.

Try to obtain these rare Unique skins through Skin Combination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/154b8cb22d918921689d00f57f69baaa96d84194.png[/img]

- Verserk Checkmate
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/6938b6f605849fcef05d301b5f119ba968ca7871.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d45e39648666e0fe73e5c36a4925e5416ad6f236.jpg[/img]

Through the April patch, Exclusive Unique Skins have been added newly, and we have prepared one skin for each weapon class.

The list will keep expanding in future patches, so please stay tuned!

Thank you

A.V.A Global Operation Team

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/ecc4381fde59cc90d6e2535655bf79c296cadc44.png[/img]

Mercenaries!

Exciting news for all players of AVA! 
The April patch has just been released, and it includes the highly-anticipated A.V.A Train mode. Whether you're a seasoned veteran or a new player, this mode is sure to provide a thrilling experience.

However, we understand that not all players may find the first challenge easy.
In order to ensure the best gaming experience, we have prepared a [u][b]'Combat Respawn Supply Event' [/b][/u]that will allow users to go through the AVA train and defeat all bosses with the help of additional 'Combat Respawn' items.

[h1]['Combat Respawn' Supply Event!][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/f7840eecba9d61a9d7a98d7c688e5c13a0e4d230.jpg[/img]

Starting from [b]April 24, 2023, at 07:00 AM[/b], the [b]Normal difficulty mode[/b] will open. 
This means you will face bigger challenges and may require [b]more 'Combat Respawn' items[/b] to complete the round successfully.

In order to help all Mercenaries, if you play AVA Train Mode every day during the schedule below, we will provide you with a [b]"10 times/ 30 days Combat Respawn" item*1[/b] after the event schedule ends.

[b]Event Details: [/b]From April 22nd to April 23rd, 2023, play AVA Train Mode every day and receive a  [b]"10 times/ 30 days Combat Respawn" item*1[/b]

- Rewards will be sent within 3 business days after the event finishes.
- You must play at least 5 mins in a match to be successfully counted.

[h1]What is 'Combat Respawn'?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1bfe767b263e38d65eb605198d5d6117bc70f71a.png[/img]

Combat Respawn is an item that can be used without being equipped, and it will be consumed when the player is resurrected in A.V.A Train Mode. Therefore, this item plays a crucial role in helping you successfully complete the mission.

Items that are depleted or expired will be automatically removed from your inventory.

Don't forget to invite all your friends to play AVA Global today!

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operation Team

notes.title: A.V.A Global Train Mode - It's Time To Move Forward!
notes.content:
[h1]1. Introducing 'AVA Train'[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/b29a730926c60165cba133f54710cc155bd13e72.jpg[/img]

[h2]Story Overview:[/h2]
- During Erdmann's sinister experiments, he kept a group of villains and test subjects confined in his secret train with the intention of using them to spread a deadly infection and create a new empire. 

In response, a joint operation was launched by the EU and NRF to put an end to his dangerous schemes. Unfortunately, during the process, all of the individuals perished, with only two survivors left.

- These 2 survivors are the last hope to save humanity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/86f228c366581edb790393a5d7231490639e60df.jpg[/img]

[h2]Key Features of 'AVA Train'[/h2]
[list]
[*] A PvE progressive scenario mode with five chapters and over 30 train cars in total.
[*] Features all AIs that have appeared in AVA Global so far (Villain All-Stars & Chapter Bosses).
[*]AI with unique attack patterns and powerful enemies to encounter across different stages.
[*] Upgrade option of ATK/HP through a growth system (enhancing both co-op and role-playing elements)
[*] Utilization of special weapons to overcome crisis situations and take on bosses (providing an exhilarating experience of firepower).
[*] Co-op play with friends through two-player mode.
[/list]

[h2]3. AVA Train Schedule[/h2]

Following the April 20 patch, we will be introducing A.V.A Train mode on Easy difficulty to help you get started.

Once you're comfortable with the gameplay, the normal difficulty will be available on Monday, April 24, and will continue through Thursday.

Please note that the difficulty level may be adjusted after that.

To ensure the best experience, we suggest that players become familiar with the content before April 20, as a more challenging difficulty may be unlocked at that time.

[b][AVA Train Schedule][/b]
Easy Mode: (UTC) 2023. 04. 20 (after April Patch) ~ 2023. 04. 24 07:00 AM
Normal Mode: (UTC) 2023. 04. 24 07:00 AM ~ 2023. 04. 27 07:00 AM

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/6e9063f33c9606a11f00f5ee03fe168f8a66a6cb.jpg[/img]

[h2]4. Gameplay & Rewards[/h2]

Chapter 1: Escape from the prison cell and confront new guards along with the deadly 'Combat Enhancer Type B+' on the train.
Chapter 2: Engage in an intense combat against the 'Enhanced Infection Host' aboard the train.
Chapter 3: Explore a variety of action/puzzle play and the battle against the 'Evolved Battle Gear Legion'.
Chapter 4: Fight with evolved slash techniques on an open train and face off against 'Clone Panfilov 2'.
Chapter 5: Engage in the final showdown against the train's ultimate boss, 'Erdmann I Consummate'."

[h2]5. Mode Reward[/h2]

For successfully completing the mode, you'll get a random chance to obtain [b]exclusive rewards[/b]: the [u][b]'Erdman Mask' and 'Red Erdman Mask.'[/b][/u]

The likelihood of obtaining these limited items will vary based on the difficulty level, meaning that you'll receive them faster if you complete the mode on a higher difficulty level.

We've introduced the [b]"AI Life" respawn item[/b] to help make the new mode more manageable. So, feel free to give it a try!

[b][Erdman Mask][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/23cd988f08fc11198eab2af40c2577790a2f0d36.png[/img]

[b][Red Erdman Mask][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/9b0ce189d4d9905ea48347e351e7bcbc778b456a.png[/img]

[h2]6. A.V.A Train Liquid Machine Open[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/3b8249dd8c2835b51afe6d865d9df67def6c6d66.jpg[/img]

To celebrate the launch of A.V.A Train Mode, we are excited to announce the release of a special Point Man skin. 
Mark your calendars for the following schedule to get your hands on this special skin!
 
Don't miss out on A.V.A Train Liquid Machine skin in the Capsule Shop!

[VP5K Liquid Machine Open Schedule]
- Time (UTC) 2023. 04. 17, 09:30 AM ~ Until Further Notice
Where to obtain this skin? → Capsule Shop

[h2]7. Final Infection Mode Event[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/588fcb6f3dcd3e4394066c89f53f30c950853678.jpg[/img]

[b][u]*Please note that the Infection Mode event will be coming to an end with this patch.[/u][/b]

As a special thank you to our players, we're giving away a Cursed Box for every day you play Infection Mode.

Event Details: From April 17th to April 19th, 2023, play Infection Mode every day and receive a guaranteed Cursed Box, up to a[u][b] maximum of 15 boxes[/b][/u].

You can receive up to 5 boxes per day by playing Infection Mode matches. 
(Infection Mode 1 Match → 1 Cursed Box)

[b][Event Schedule][/b]
- Time (UTC) 2023. 04. 17, 09:30 AM ~ 2023. 04. 19, 14:59 PM

[b][Note][/b]
- The match is counted when you finish the match from the Start. Staying in the lobby does not count toward playtime.
- Rewards will be sent within 3 business days after the event finishes.
- You must play at least 5 mins in a match to be successfully counted.

*Please note that the skin capsule shop schedule may be subject to change.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operation Team

notes.title: New Demolition Mode - Free2Bomb Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/63b7898ae5ab5ca70de140549269d4ad49a21f8a.jpg[/img]

Mercenaries!

As the Level Designer for AVA Global, I'm thrilled to announce the release of our latest game mode, Free2Bomb.

[h1]Put your C4 on the Front Line![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7521ade4a1faf933b91b0ceade7235b5f653683d.jpg[/img]

In Free2Bomb, we've taken the classic Demolition mode and added an exciting twist to create a fresh and unique experience. The mode closely follows the same rules as traditional Demolition, but with a core battle area that revolves around biological and chemical bombs (C4-F2B).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/8d64fe84f4592d64441f4405fedf856d7116c25e.png[/img]

The EU can acquire and place these bombs anywhere, allowing for more strategic gameplay as you choose the engagement area after installing the bomb. Unlike traditional Demolition mode, the location where the EU installs the C4-F2B becomes the core engagement area.

[h1]Mode Tips - C4 could be Anywhere[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c20e5c5a522c5b34cb9cf36ceb4c356ea6ef9bb7.jpg[/img]

We've selected India, Junkyard, and Silo as the initial service levels for F2B. The installation area balance for Demolition mission levels favors the NRF defense by default, so it may be better to capture the C4-F2B in the front and engage in the battle in a more favorable area.

[h1]Fun Part - Installing C4 in a creative way[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/abde23a16673b9bf9065ff66aabdefa9da955e46.jpg[/img]

But the most enjoyable part of Free2Bomb is setting up C4-F2B in unexpected places and defending them. This brings a fun change of pace from traditional Demolition mode, and we encourage you to experiment with different setups and find your own must-win strategies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1765ecfbeb0c59194b91a4ba9a7bcca1c26c370b.jpg[/img]

We appreciate our AVA Global users' love of Demolition Mission, and we've been working hard to make it even more enjoyable. Free2Bomb is the culmination of one of our ideas, and we'll continue to work hard to make Avatar even more exciting.

Thank you for playing, and we hope you enjoy the new Free2Bomb mode!

[u][b]*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.
[/b][/u]

Thank you.

Sincerely,

Your AVA Global Level Designer

notes.title: Leave your mark on the game - Spray your way to victory!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/ccdf903b48102299f9d27c6e861ce3ca2058bd32.png[/img]

Mercenaries!

We are thrilled to announce the arrival of the Spray System as part of the A.V.A Global Season 3 update.

The Spray System is an exciting new feature that enables you to express a range of emotions and thoughts with your team members as you navigate the battlefield together. Whether you want to motivate your squad or simply add some personality to your gameplay, the Spray System is the perfect tool to do so.

We hope you enjoy this new addition to the game and look forward to seeing how you use it to enhance your A.V.A Global experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/b02388c8280c629fc261723d3da7a5c77e927249.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/30f45097f8b3d2aaff1d76b8d562e3d141d797a7.png[/img]

These items can be easily equipped in your inventory and used in various locations within the game, including walls and ground surfaces throughout the battlefield.

To mark the debut of the Spray System, we will be offering some free spray skins to all players. These skins are a token of our appreciation and a testament to our commitment to delivering the best gaming experience possible.

Additionally, a wide selection of diverse and dynamic spray skins can be obtained through our battle passes and in-game store. We believe that this variety of options will allow you to express your unique personality and style in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/16f5266b5b73f3fca415abc652ad2699493c307d.jpg[/img]

The A.V.A. DUCK series skins are a colloection of skins that represent the trainee "[b]Duck[/b]" in A.V.A Global. By equipping these skins, you'll be able to express a range of emotions and attitudes on the battlefield, adding a unique dimension to your gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0eaee90f8fa4a85edb5a09288e16665549841b60.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/a003e767a06044501df5a120676eb22a7fc1a86d.jpg[/img]

This skin is one of a kind and reflects the unique and daring aesthetic of the Caiman Weapon series. As a player, you'll have the opportunity to add it to your collection and showcase it on the battlefield, making a bold statement and setting yourself apart from other players.

Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: A.V.A Global - Dev Letter March
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e5577065fbdd29c12475e9441e603d7b31d734f4.png[/img]

Mercenaries!

Exciting news, everyone! Get ready for a thrilling new update to our beloved game! Our team has been working tirelessly over the past few months to bring you an even better gameplay experience, packed with thrilling new features and enhanced gameplay.

Prepare yourself for a sneak peek at what's to come: a brand-new game mode, breathtaking skins, innovative gameplay systems, and so much more! We can't wait to share all the exciting details with you, so stay tuned for the big reveal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/96c912e2821a2ff8128aebd4d85e5f41d4eac353.png[/img]

[h1]New Mode: Free2Bomb[/h1]

Get ready for a fresh take on your favorite bombing missions with the all-new Free2Bomb mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/63b7898ae5ab5ca70de140549269d4ad49a21f8a.jpg[/img]

Get ready to shake up your bombing strategy with our thrilling new game mode, F2B! This exciting mode brings a fresh twist to traditional bombing missions by introducing biological munitions (C4-F2B) that EU teams can acquire from existing installation areas and place anywhere they want.

But that's not all - the core engagement area has also been revamped, making F2B vastly different from the traditional Demolition mode. With new challenges and strategies to explore, F2B promises to keep you on the edge of your seat with every mission.

Stay tuned for more details on this exciting new mode before the next update, and get ready to blow away the competition with your new F2B skills!


[h1]Spray System:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/639d7f6ac242f3057dda7661ad1c42e106e8bc54.png[/img]

Looking for a new way to have fun in-game?
Say hello to the Spray System!

We are introducing this brand-new feature to AVA Global for the first time.
This new system will provide you with scalable content in-game, that will add even more fun to your gameplay.

Try using this Spray System to send different messages to your teammates and opponents.
We'll be adding more items to the system in future updates, and you can expect to see the "Duck" and "Caiman" in the upcoming March update.

Get ready to spray and play!

[h1]New Season, New Changes[/h1]

[h3]>Battle Pass: Season 3 'Core'[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c9479dc55264683c6ca2da94cb09218451cb051e.png[/img]

As winter draws to a close, so does Season 2 - Bloody Bark. We want to take a moment to express our gratitude to all our fans who supported us during this epic season. Your enthusiasm and dedication have made it a resounding success.

But don't fret, because we've got even bigger things in store for Season 3 - Core, which will kick off with our upcoming update. And to sweeten the deal, the Season 3 Battle Pass will unlock the exclusive "CORE" seasonal skin, guaranteed to make your enemies tremble with fear.

And that's not all - we've also got an exciting lineup of other skins in store for you, so keep your eyes peeled for updates on what's to come. Get ready to level up and dominate the competition in Season 3 - Core!



[h3]>ARENA Rework[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/fd5804873dcfc61f28c7e2b66c260e1f2f8d8031.png[/img]

Get ready for an all-new ARENA Season format as we gear up for Season 4! We're excited to introduce a revamped structure that will provide a more cohesive and engaging experience for players.

And that's not all - after the conclusion of Arena Season 3, we'll be launching Arena Season 4 with the next update, so get ready to dive back in for another round of intense competition.

The new format will feature shorter durations but still offer rich rewards, so get ready to compete like never before and climb the ranks to become the ultimate champion. Stay tuned for more details on what's to come in the next exciting season of ARENA!


[h3]> Game Usability Fixes:[/h3]

As we transition into a new season, we've made some improvements to the game's usability.

The winter lobby will be replaced with a new "Spring" concept lobby to coincide with the change of seasons.

Additionally, the In-Game Store categories have been revamped as well to make it easier for users to find and purchase skins.

Look out for new "Spring" skins as part of the In-Game Store overhaul!

As we head into the new season, we're working on various things to bring you more content and fun in AVA Global.

Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to enjoy all the new content coming your way!

[u][b]*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.
[/b][/u]

Thank you.

Sincerely,

Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: Hide & Seek Mode!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d16972197cf264d477ae02d102173e0faa877c8e.png[/img]

Mercenaries!

Through this February Patch, sniper annihilation mode will be closed, and the "Hide & Seek" mode will be newly added to A.V.A Global to welcome you. 

Hide & Seek mode allows you to experience a new play experience of being chased and seeking, not a battle play method like the existing modes. 

[h1]Hide & Seek Mode[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7f90ec04e98cd162fb6007a0052c833b6cee35a7.png[/img]

The rules are simple: one team becomes the Taggers, and the other becomes the Objects.
If you are in the Object Team, you will select one of the three objects and transform into that object.
Once you turn into the object of your choice, you must hide in the appropriate location before the game starts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/19f5515d1a12080b28390f17f4a73267564aa94f.png[/img]

Each object player can remove previously placed objects up to three times per round.
Utilizing this feature effectively will help you win the game against the taggers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1c97877eafa69d9c2cbaf1f279e79422efe22dd1.jpg[/img]

When the game starts, the Tagger Team has to find the Object Team hidden all over the map.

After a certain period of time, the surviving Object Team will undergo a second transformation randomly.
At this point, players need to react quickly to the changed situation.

notes.title: A.V.A Global Dev Letter - 2023 Febuary
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/99412c0181919b1056552682a48004f73b68d3eb.png[/img]

Dear Mercenaries,

Greetings!

I am the AVA Global Balancing Designer, and I am excited to introduce myself to you for the first time through this Developer Letter. 

It is my pleasure to be able to provide you with details regarding the upcoming balance patches for several weapons in the game.

First of all, here’s a little background on why we’re rebalancing weapons.

One of the most prominent features of AVA is the Three-Class System: Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper.

Despite the Rifleman being intended as the centerpiece of the three classes, it is played less by users compared to the other classes.

Additionally, the other weapons belonging to the Rifleman class, apart from the MA-47, are not meeting their intended roles as expected.

To address this current issue, we have made balance adjustments for X4A1 and X36.


[b]<X4A1>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/73b030de0fa1c4337aab0cb1b536996b04e7b5f9.png[/img]

-     Reduced ATK damage variance

-     Increased range and Rate of Fire

-     Significantly increased DPS

X4A1 is one of the users’ favorite weapons for its high rate of fire and accuracy.

These changes will make up for its relatively weak ATK damage compared to other weapons and provide users with greater satisfaction.

[b]<X36>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/78c3f02be6b0c9a05504281ab13ab7d9db997562.png[/img]

-     Increased ATK and Rate of Fire

-     Modified recoil pattern for easier gun operation

X36 is a mid-range combat weapon with high accuracy, but it has a recoil problem.

We have modified the recoil pattern to make it easier for users to operate.
Our Development Team always strives to improve the quality of the game based on your feedback.

Our utmost priority is to ensure a fun and engaging gaming experience while upholding game balance, and we remain committed to achieving this goal.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
AVA Global Balancing Designer

notes.title: A.V.A Global January Patch Note
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/b9249d62e256de53df2c89bcb1e4b2c142e3d70b.png[/img]

Mercenaries!

The Patch Notes for the January patch are finally here!

This patch contains various features, such as a new mode, content, and new skins that will be revealed gradually.

The skins that will be added immediately following this update are attractive too, but we will also open additional limited skins for Valentine's Day soon, so please stay tuned!

[h1]New Mode: Infection Mode[/h1]

Map: Burning Temple, Dark Chamber, Dual Site, Prison Break

As the first update in 2023, we have added a new mode - [b]Infection[/b] - to provide gamers with a more diverse gameplay experience.

[previewyoutube=wM0Je0WbJSc;full][/previewyoutube]

When you play Infection, you will encounter a whole new enemy that you have never met in A.V.A Global before.

This will provide an exciting gaming experience and a completely new gaming style.

"Infection" is a mode in which one of the players becomes an infected monster and tries to infect all the humans.

The "infected" will win if they successfully infect all the humans, and the humans will win if they defeat all the infected monsters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e754b5024c6ff666d01f923a4738d48b7f3babec.jpg[/img]

You will be able to enjoy "[b]villain play[/b]" more in this A.V.A Global Infection mode since we have reinforced the creature features of the "infectious agents," allowing you to feel a little more superior when playing.

The infectious agents are classified into [b]"Spore Host" and "Bubble Host."[/b]

The "Spore Host" carries one spore that can be used to attack and damage the enemy, and the "Bubble Host" carries 10 bubbles that can temporarily pause the enemy's movements.

The infectious agents have a little more HP, and although the genus has been slightly enhanced, there are no additional advantages.

Spore damage deducts 3 HP per second and lasts over 10 seconds to deduct 30 HP in total.

However, you can only have one spoiler, so try to use it effectively as your final weapon; otherwise, you will fall into a more challenging situation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/05334c4fb31547c2b5ae566b33a44ed1ba4ad059.jpg[/img]

In "Infection," the screen has been darkened to allow users to become more immersed in the gameplay.

Due to the darkened vision, the players will be able to feel the tension, and the infectious agent will be unable to find them easily.

Since the repeated gameplay on a fixed map can be tedious, we added cabinet objects to create more hiding space for humans.

If humans hide in the cabinets, each infectious agent will have to spend more time looking for the hiding humans; this adds to the thrills of the game by allowing the humans to overcome their fear and survive until the end of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7fc131c96cc5780a23bb48d4165c8c357493d3a0.jpg[/img]

As a reward for this new mode, a "[b]Cursed Box[/b]" will be added, which you can receive along with the Premium Box & AVA Box.

The method of receiving the rewards is the same as in the Demolition.

The process for receiving rewards is the same as it is in the standard Demolition mode.

There is also a special item reward that can only be obtained in the “Cursed Box” of “Infection,” so please participate.

notes.title: SKIN COMBINATION SYSTEM Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/69936808b9e8b33a2ffdd70d816d4eaa039bc2fe.jpg[/img]

Mercenaries!

The [b]"Skin Combination"[/b] system is a feature we are introducing to you for the first time; it is A.V.A Global's new trial and a brand-new game system you have not seen before.

This is fascinating content that will broaden your in-game play experiences.

Now, let's take this opportunity to learn about the Skin Combination system!

[h1]Skin Combination Basie Rules:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0c794804c91c1f0fa45ef1e7f4104e68e99e6c1a.png[/img]

"Skin Combination" is a mechanic of consuming two weapon skins to obtain a new weapon skin.

If you proceed with the Skin Combination, you will consume a certain amount of Euros.
Weapons used as materials for Combination will NOT be returned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/8419d6c2ff365016df24bba1004eee646b150ad0.png[/img]

Skin Combination is restricted to each group: Pointman, Rifleman, Sniper.
Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and the weapon of the same group will be obtained through a combination process.

Tiers of weapons that can be used as Combination materials are [b]"Regular," "Epic," and "Premium."[/b]

The tier of the Combination result depends on the tiers of materials. In general, using high-tier skins as materials increases the probability of high-tier results.


[u][b]Exclusive Unique Skin[/b][/u] - From Skin Combination, general Unique tier skins cannot be obtained.

However, there are exclusive Unique skins that can only be obtained through Skin Combination.

Try to obtain these rare Unique skins through Skin Combination.

[i][b]*Note:
-Items that CAN NOT be used as materials for Skin Combination are as follows:
>Items that are not of "Regular," "Epic," or "Premium" tiers.
>Items that are in the 'Unique' tier.
>Items that are the new base weapon(MA-47M & WCX-SBR) skins.
>Currently equipped items.
>Items on Favorites.

Exclusive Unique skins can be obtained by combining the weapons from the same groups.
Pointman skin can only be obtained by combining two Pointman skins.[/b][/i]

[h1]Skin Combination Exclusive Skins:[/h1]

Typical Unique tier skins cannot be acquired in the Skin Combination system.

However, exclusive Unique tier skins can only be obtained through the Skin Combination process.

[h2]Exclusive Unique tier Skin List:[/h2]

- Bahamut Blue Valkyrie
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/73452ed5045ab8fce0453dfe4095175439048973.png[/img]

- MA-47 Mammon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/818406f35a2e516c022c0cb46ed24cced3e34e35.png[/img]

- SR-F2 Gold Horse
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1a08d5e22c597f67ce0553f3c051c235885db9d0.png[/img]

The Exclusive Unique Skins will be added for the first time after the patch, and we have prepared one skin for each weapon class.

The list will expand in future patches, so please stay tuned!

Thank you

A.V.A Global Operation Team

notes.title: A.V.A Global Dev Letter - January 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7a52a2d3270ec586309f0277e9d62f80e06d801a.png[/img]

Mercenaries!

We are very excited to present to you the first developer letter of 2023.
Through this letter, we would like to introduce you to the major patch that will be made next week. 

This patch is full of amazing news, including a new mode, new content, and more!

[u][b]*"This Dev letter does not include all of the content of the patch; you can discover additional information about the patch in the patch notes that will be issued later."[/b][/u]

[h1]<New Mode - Fight Against the New Enemy!>[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e754b5024c6ff666d01f923a4738d48b7f3babec.jpg[/img]

As the first patch in 2023, we have added a new mode -[b] Infection Mode[/b] - to provide gamers with a more diverse gameplay experience. 

In this new "Infection" mode, you will face a whole new enemy that you have never met in A.V.A Global before. This will provide you with an intensive gaming experience as well as a completely new gameplay style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7fc131c96cc5780a23bb48d4165c8c357493d3a0.jpg[/img]

"Infection" is a mode in which one of the players becomes an infected monster and tries to infect all the humans. The infected can win if they successfully infect all the humans, and the humans can win if they defeat all the infected monsters.

Please look forward to this new mode, as [u][b]it is a specially reworked "Infection Mode," only for A.V.A global![/b][/u]

[h1]<New System - Skin Combination System>[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0c794804c91c1f0fa45ef1e7f4104e68e99e6c1a.png[/img]

We'd like to introduce you to the Skin Combination System for the first time, a new endeavor by A.V.A Global that will be implemented via a patch next week!

This content is an entirely new in-game system you have not seen before, and we are confident that it will provide you with a wider variety of gameplay experiences.

Shooting is the most crucial part of playing A.V.A Global, as it is the core content and a vital element of the game.

Therefore, we strive to provide users with the most choices and opportunities to offer them the most diversified shooting experiences possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/8419d6c2ff365016df24bba1004eee646b150ad0.png[/img]

The new Skin Combination system will provide users with an entirely new experience, allowing them to utilize less-used or redundant skins to obtain new skins efficiently.

[h1]<New Battlefield - South American Server Open>[/h1]

The following significant change this patch is bringing is the opening of the "South American" Server.

We plan to open a new server in this patch to improve the gameplay environment for South American users.

Through this enhancement, A.V.A Global will be accessible to a broader range of users, resulting in a more stable and enjoyable gaming environment.

[h1]<Weapon Balancing - Various Options & Enjoyable Shooting Play>[/h1]

[b][M1903][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/5e0cafcdc1d31f2090e4ccf9983597eeb75e9444.png[/img]

A.V.A Global has added several modes so far, and elements like map changes/additions and varied classes allow users to experience weapon balance in different ways.

We are continuously thinking about balancing weapons to give users a better overall shooting experience, which is A.V.A Global's core content.

Following the last weapon balancing, another significant balancing patch will also be made this time.

[b][Silver Arrow][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/951f278a9512bf814600aeaf3180feb04aaa5bd5.png[/img]

To further broaden the players' choices, we rebalanced some sniper weapons.

First, Armour Piercing will be altered for M1903, X24, and Silver Arrow, and the ATK and Range of M1903 will be adjusted in accordance with the balance work.

Silver Arrow and X24's close-range One-Shot Kill chances will be increased to make the game more user-friendly.

While preserving the unique elements of A.V.A Global, we'll keep giving users additional opportunities to enjoy using a variety of weapons and providing realistic and varied gameplay experiences.

Ultimately, this Balancepatch aims to provide more engaging shooting play experiences by maximizing diversity and making the game more enjoyable.

[h1][b]<New Weapons & Skins>[/b][/h1]

Similar to the previous patch, various weapons will also be added through this patch with the new skins.

[b][Desmodus Valentine][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/ecf9427e59fdd07505e7b86991adba8fa32a9310.png[/img]

[b][MA-47 Mammon][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/48cb68238ec5aff7de0776c0332bfab2567a187f.png[/img]

Please pay close attention since [b]MA-74M and WCX-SBR[/b] will also be added as new base weapons, along with a Valentine's Day limited skin and new skins to celebrate the patch.

[b][MA-74M][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/87f0a3fd281359dd7fa3527f05a5f6af217a0b25.png[/img]

[b][WCX-SBR][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7a4f584d9f54b271c7342b548904659c90eee0d7.png[/img]

[u][b]"Please note that the above introduction is subject to change based on internal conditions"[/b][/u]

Thank you.



Sincerely,

Your A.V.A Global Development Team

notes.title: [PREVIEW] December Patch Note
notes.content:
Mercenaries! 

After careful consideration, the December update will bring you exciting content!
[u][b]*Please note that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned information may be subject to change[/b][/u]

[h1]New Mode: Infinity Domination[/h1]
[h2]Map: Crash Point[/h2]
In particular, in the upcoming December update, we plan to release a PVE & PVP hybrid mode, known as "Infinite Domination" after the December update.
[previewyoutube=SySlBmKRXIQ;full][/previewyoutube]

In Infinite Domination, mercenaries have to capture and occupy a site to win the round. Your team engineers fix the computers which fill the site occupancy.
Each mercenary has 5 life points from the beginning of the match but will lose a life point after death or if failed to occupy the site.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/809626a58ed1fe71c70ca6e2ce3e5c607d88482d.png[/img]

As the match progresses, it becomes more and more challenging as stronger enemies spawn.
Mercenaries can overcome these challenges by picking up items such as grenade launchers and more.
On this battlefield, you get to opportunity to obtain the 'Rosewell' skin series which is only obtainable in this mode. There are various tiers in the 'Roswell' skins, do your best to collect them all.

Lastly, you can obtain a very special drop reward from this mode that'll add more fun to the gameplay.
Roswell Backpack, Roswell Box, and Roswell Chest will drop when eliminating the in-game mid-bosses.
Drop rewards allow you to receive Roswell series skin items with a certain probability.

notes.content:

notes.content:
Mercenaries!

Before the December Update begins, we would like to welcome you to the last skin update of the year.

In this update, we have a series of Bloody Bark skins, mysterious Roswell skins, and many others!
The various skins are to be released in Season 2. These skins will be obtainable through a new mode, and the in-game shop!
Make sure not to miss this opportunity and celebrate the end of the year with the new skins!

[h1]Infinity Domination - Roswell Skin Series[/h1]

In Infinity Domination, mercenaries must capture and occupy a site to win the round. Your team technicians fix the computers which fill the site occupancy.
Each mercenary has 5 life points from the beginning of the match but will lose a life point after death or if failed to occupy the site.

As the match progresses, it becomes more and more challenging as stronger AI enemies spawn.
Mercenaries can overcome these challenges by picking up items such as grenade launchers and more.
On this battlefield, you get the opportunity to obtain the 'Roswell skin,' which is only obtainable through this mode. There are various tiers in the 'Roswell' skins, so try your best to collect them all.

notes.title: INFINITY DOMINATION Announcement
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

After the launch in August 2022, A.V.A Global is preparing for the SEASON 2 Update.
Thank you for your support and encouragement since the official launch of A.V.A Global.
With the SEASON 2 Update, A.V.A Global's unique and special mode 'Infinity Domination' will be added.

Since it's the new mode you can find only in A.V.A Global, you'll be able to experience new types of strategies and excitement.

Without further delay, let us introduce 'Infinity Domination.' to you.
[u][b]*Please note that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned information may be subject to change[/b][/u]
[previewyoutube=SySlBmKRXIQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]A.V.A Global Infinity Domination:[/h1]
[h2]1. Game rule:[/h2]
> Players are engaged in a battle over occupied territory and after the territory is occupied, all users are rotated to the next map.
>There is no fixed end to the game, and the player will have five lives. If he or she dies or the opponent takes over the territory five times, the user is sent to the lobby. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/066a46d9c986d03faa75e03d3cd8c84ab77683a2.png[/img]

[h2]2. Domination:[/h2]
> The Domination time is set differently for each map considering its features and sizes.
> Only AI Engineers can take over the territory which increases the domination status icon.
> The team with more Engineers has the advantage when occupying the territory.
> However, players do not have the option to occupy the territory by themselves.
> Domination Neutral: The domination status icon becomes “neutral” when the number of both teams AI Engineers is the same.
> When the domination becomes neutral, the domination gauge gets deducted slowly back to the initial state.
> When neutral, securing the objective (when dominated by friendly forces) / resetting the objective (when dominated by the enemy) is possible.
> Calculation for the number of people securing/resetting the objective: Player 0.5, AI Engineer 1 point each.
If the number of people is the same, then the domination gauge slowly moves toward the team that entered last.
> When the objective is dominated, players respawn in the next map after the transition scene that plays for about 8 seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/8a3bc729724eb257201b4620ae34bb00a01b7e80.png[/img]

[h2]3. Mode Appearance AI[/h2]
>There are a total of six types of AI bots: "Engineers, Guards, Medics, and hidden mid-boss AI"
>The AI's basic attack power is lower than other players, but if the opposing team takes over the territory twice in a row, the AI's attack power will continuously increase from the third round, until winning, which will reset the attack power.
>AI respawn will be balanced depending on the number of players.

[b]AI List:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/fcb999ef3b7086ef1d0439bc9df322f8e89a1d14.jpg[/img]



[h2]4. Special items:[/h2]

(Friendly forces' Signal grenade flare is white, and the enemy's flare is orange)

notes.title: BLOODY BARK SEASON 2 ROADMAP
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/81e3bb42f685a03c95c29de5c5a2293ba3f4be29.jpg[/img]

Mercenaries!

First of all, we would like to thank everyone for their continuous support from the launch to Season 1.
We'd like to take this opportunity to give you a sneak peek of what we are preparing in the upcoming update and tell you what's new for Season 2.

[h1]New Hybrid Mode[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/6ae0a23120827b7665ac0112627b1ad5332fee88.jpg[/img]

In particular, in the upcoming December update we are planning to release a PVE & PVP hybrid mode, which is known as "Infinite Domination" and after the December update,
we are considering adding additional modes during Season 2.

However, due to the current environment, there are parts that need to be systematically optimized.
We would appreciate your understanding that the modes cannot be added immediately.

In Infinite Domination, mercenaries have to capture and occupy a site to win the round. Your team engineers fix the computers which fill the site occupancy.
Each mercenary has 5 life points from the beginning of the match but will lose a life point after death or if failed to occupy the site.

As the match progresses, it becomes more and more challenging as stronger enemies spawn.
Mercenaries can overcome these challenges by picking up items such as grenade launchers and more.
On this battlefield, you get to opportunity to obtain the 'Rosewell' which is only given in this more. There are various tiers in the 'Rosewell' skins, do your best to get them all.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/40eb3d2116046c4b333a5113a08d86e8864fb80e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Community Safety Upgrade and Arena Improvements[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d14c9108200b2891e35d6c19a227c771effe1bc2.png[/img]

We understand community safety is an utmost concern that many mercenaries have voiced their opinions about, especially about the Arena Beta seasons.

We hear you LOUD and CLEAR! In addition to the existing anti-cheat, we will introduce additional effective countermeasures against those who violate the Code of Conduct and End User License Agreement (EULA).
We take community safety VERY seriously; there is no forgiveness for those who ruin the gameplay experience of others.
And, we will do our best to create a safer game environment for ARENA Official Season.

[h1]New Valiant Membership[/h1]
To curb indiscriminate participation in botting and illegal program usage, the Valiant Membership will be introduced for exclusive club members to participate in Arena.

The benefits of Arena participation and ranking will be improved at the same time. This membership will also bring you member dedicated rewards.

Also, we will partially include items to the Valiant Membership reward which is included in last season's Unique Soldier Box.

[h1]Battle Pass Season 2[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c9479dc55264683c6ca2da94cb09218451cb051e.png[/img]

As Battle Pass season 1 has concluded, Season 2 is being prepared and will open shortly. Thank you so much for your interest and participation in Season 1.

After the first attempt of Battle Pass, our team has been working diligently to bring you a more complete battle pass.

We are focusing on improving rewards and extending the Battle Pass Levels. Also, there will be missions in the battle pass for extra exp!

[h1]Item Balancing[/h1]
Our team has been listening to your feedback regarding the Item balancing. This will be introduced. 
We have been paying attention to them throughout the various social platforms. We will go into more detail about this in the upcoming patch notes.

We will continue to listen to your suggestions and feedback. We hope you are looking forward to the December update. Make sure to share AVA Global with all of your friends! 

We will continue to improve the game and provide a better experience!

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operations Team

[*] Improved: [i]Game Start[/i] > Monthly Reward> Daily Reward > Item Repurchase Notice

notes.title: Black Snake Update!
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

As you know, various skin items were added through the October update yesterday.
You may have discovered nostalgia skins, and new skins you have never seen before.

Today, we're going to introduce you to the items that were added through this update.

[h1]1. Black Snake Pack
[/h1]The Black Snake series skins have been wanted by many fans even before A.V.A Global launch, 
so we have made it into a Black Snake package for users!.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/974c79dd7fd3404bdc2e2d492ad110f2244534da.jpg[/img]
The Black Snake series is a specially made skin based on the MK-47 and Desmodus weapons, which are always chosen as popular weapons.

The MA-47 Black Snake is an impressive assault rifle model with a scandium-coated special structure.
Desmodus Black Snake is an SMG model with a scandium-coated special structure for an impressive look.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/f127f8438ee8e60139701d7d8146f0ba6eeb540b.jpg[/img]
In addition, the throwable grenade 'M67 Black Snake' and the secondary weapon 'Hatchet Black Snake' are designed distinctly different from conventional weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/64e12c0301f5df114c093dd301b531988bfdff18.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c269165efaf1bc33f5e9184f72b0016501042892.jpg[/img]
Black Snake Pack item list:
- MA-47 Black Snake
- Desmodus Black Snake
- M67 Black Snake
- Hatchet Black Snake

Where: In-game Shop >> AVA MEDAL >> Medal

[h1]2. October Shop Update & New Items
[/h1]We're sure some users have already found it through this update, but at the In-Game Shop,
'Lu-08 Dragon' and 'M67 Dragon Grenade' have been added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7837e9f37fad4daff05b3e54688e0faa10e205d1.png[/img]
The Lu-08 Dragon is a handgun model with a special design that is given to those who are recognized as reserve members of the secret association, Krsnik Dragoon.

The M67 Dragon Grenade is a dedicated pattern throwing grenade that is secretly provided only to targets recognized as prospective members of the secret association, Krsnik Dragon.

We hope you enjoy this Dragon series item, which has been added splendidly with a new update.

Where: Shop >> Weapon >> ALL >> Secondary & Grenade

[h1]3. October Box Update
[/h1]Finally, through this update, we inform you of the changes in the components of the existing Titanium Box, Ava Box, and Premium Box.
- 'Kriss Venom' item is added to Titanium Box Components
- 'X16A4 Brass Vein' & 'SD5 Sulfur' are added to AVA Box and Premium Box
- The component 'Kriss Venom' has been changed to 'EUROS' in the AVA Box (you no longer can obtain Kriss Venom in the AVA Box).

PLAY NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1473480/AVA_Global/

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.content:
Mercenaries!

Today the October update has been finally carried out!

In this update, not just in-game content was added, but a large-scale update was made in the overall game system.
Through this update, we have prepared a special skin that users have been waiting for, and various in-game content will be provided.

[b]1.Monthly Reward[/b]
First of all, the Monthly Reward system is a reward system that was added to give you more rewards by attendance.

The newly added Unique Soldier Box is a special limited item for all users to celebrate the update.

You can purchase an additional one per user at the in-game store before the 7th day of Monthly Reward attendance (from Day 1 to Day 6).
[u][b]Please note that when you receive the Unique Soldier Box as a reward on the 7th day of the Month Reward system, you cannot purchase it at the store.[/b][/u]

*ex: If users get the 'MA-47 Master', users can get the reward 'MA-47 Glaucos'

Achievement System Skin Reward list:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/8e73848069bc6184bde855e10b25f2d3992c4fd1.png[/img]

notes.title: ARENA MODE IS READY!
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

Arena Mode is a new game mode that will be added to 'A.V.A Global' in the upcoming October update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d14c9108200b2891e35d6c19a227c771effe1bc2.png[/img]
As the arena mode will be opened for the first time through this update, the arena season will be held in the form of 'BETA SEASON' for the first & second seasons.

Arena mode is a high concentrating intense mode that is quite different than any other mode. And this mode is focused on the users' skills.
[u]We have to state that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned timelines may be subject to change.[/u]

[b]ARENA Season Date:[/b]
ARENA BETA SEASON 1: 14th Oct. 2022 00: 00(UTC) ~ 4th Nov. 2022 00: 00(UTC)
ARENA BETA SEASON 2: 11th Nov. 2022 00: 00(UTC) ~ 2nd Dec. 2022 00: 00(UTC)

[b]ARENA RULE:[/b]
The seasons are short however, it will not affect the Arena rewards users will receive.

First of all, until the official Season, users with the rank of 'Staff Sergeant lvl 1' or higher can participate.
[u]*Don't worry. We will hold an experience boost event for users who have not yet achieved the class.[/u]

The Arena Match will be held with 10 participants in a 5v5 match. The team that has 7 Wins out of 13 Rounds wins the game.

In Arena mode, you must participate more carefully since friendly fire is applied.

Finally, the Arena Match is a team match that can accommodate up to 10 players, so if you escape from a game that has already started playing, your ranking points will be deducted immediately.
Therefore, users who participate in the match hope to fight together until the end of the match to win and achieve a higher rank.

[b]ARENA Ranking:[/b]
Arena season rankings can earn ranking points according to users' play, and if you win an arena match, you can earn ranking points, and if you lose, ranking points will be deducted.
However, as we are hosting the beta season for the first time, we will set a "novice safety section" for users
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/8e1f7c042cedc1ce98bf65d5fdfdfea03afbb9b6.png[/img]
*You can check the ARENA RANKING from the 'RANKING' ICON.

So users with 1400 points or less, the ranking points will not be deducted even if they lose the game.
* Users with 1401 points or higher will be deducted from their RP in case of defeat, but will not be lower than 1401 points.

At the start of the Arena season, all users have 1200 base ranking points, and if they have not participated in ARENA for 10 days at the time of the last change in RP,
5 points per day are deducted up to 1200 points of RP, and users with an RP of 1500 or less are not deducted.

[b]ARENA Map:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d93eb97a7aee1f69493cf4793a4d6cc648a1aa5e.png[/img]

[b]Arena Rewards:[/b]
As we mentioned in the last post, we plan to provide this arena reward in as many forms as possible.
As long as you participate in ARENA BETA Season 1, users can receive a 'Unique Soldier Box' as an Arena Mode participation reward.
*If you participate the ARENA MODE 50 matches, you will get one Unique Soldier Box.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/37566c7599b64e625ff46af82dee9807530dc3be.png[/img]

In addition, users who rank 1st to 100th in the season will receive[b] Arena Season Limited 'HG21C Sand' Skin[/b] Reward.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/cc5a22337d9d6e056c9153c53d7f1f9aa3df0f8a.png[/img]
Arena Personal Rating Rewards can be received on a rank point basis that you earn every season, and if you earn a higher tier, you can receive a better reward.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/54d694aed8f24ad2240a055e0dc3a4b487dc0607.jpg[/img]
Arena mode is a new mode being added, if you take your time and play this mode, you will definitely have fun playing it!

We will continue to add additional features in Arena Mode through future updates.

Please enjoy it!

Sincerely,

Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: Are You Ready to Be a Unique Soldier?
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

'A.V.A Global' was officially launched on August 25th, and finally, our October update is around the corner!

For this update, we have prepared a lot for everyone who misses the old content.
In addition, new item skin information is scheduled to be introduced today and the new mode is planned to be introduced tomorrow.

[u][b]We have to state that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned timelines may be subject to change.[/b][/u]

First, we thought about how we would deliver more content and more item rewards to users.
We added a new item to commemorate this update to give more diverse rewards to many users who love 'A.V.A Global'.

Unique Soldier Box
As the name suggested, [u]we have prepared unique and special skins [b]based on 10 different base weapons[/b].[/u]

For example, [b]Guardian Coral[/b] is a variant of the Guardian with neon tropical paint.
[b]870 Blue Skull[/b] is a limited model of 870 featuring a customized barrel.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/8279c5763e6cda1fb5bea842a51c9ff194aac8c2.png[/img]

As well as, other base weapon skins which have their own special points too.

Unique Soldier Box
As the name states, the Unique Soldier Box is a special box where you can obtain unique and special items.
We are confident that all content in this box is unique, and all items will satisfy the person opening it.
Don't worry! If you participate ARENA MODE 50 matches, you will get Unique Soldier Box x 1!
You can check the item from the image below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0586b9bd0b414b8b3402e4f89de13d252de7ec8b.jpg[/img]

[b]Unique Soldier Box Item list:[/b]
*Unique Soldier Box items are purchasable with Medals at the In-game Shop.
 (or getting from the Arena Mode Rewards)
[list]
[*] Guardian Coral
[*] Temporal Platina
[*] Zebra Cyclops
[*] SR-F2 Legend
[*] Xako Chrome
[*] Bahamut Origin
[*] MA-47 Gold dragon
[*] EPKO
[*] X4A1 Graffiti
[*] 870 Blue Skull
[/list]

Although, if you purchase the product directly from the store, you can only purchase it once, if you participate in the Arena, you can obtain it through the Arena Mode Rewards!

The Arena mode can be participated by users above the Saff Sergeant Lvl1,
and the box can be obtained not only as an Arena rank reward but also as a participation reward.

We will provide detailed information on ARENA mode through the following Announcements.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: Season 1 [Venom] Battle Pass
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/046e202abd2d20bbb36a70135e588d551e93cd04.jpg[/img]
[h3]What is a Battle Pass?[/h3]
Venom Battle Pass starts from the [b]26th of Aug to the 30th of November[/b]. The Venom Battle Pass gives mercenaries access to in-game cosmetics, ammo upgrades, Euros, and Venom season skins. 

Included in the Venom Battle Pass are 3 new base weapons and Venom season skins. Plus we've added more Euros on the Regular pass for all mercenaries! 
[b][X-TPS][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/be8731955fbef9ff6e8dfba2b3c7b66cac141853.jpg[/img]
[b][EL-85 RAIL][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/f899b0641ea193c25ae0abbebeace48ac21f2630.jpg[/img]
[b][XN PSR BALLISTA][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/299d900085e2155b2c997984f9ebcbcc74e40d26.jpg[/img]
[h3]How to acquire Battle Pass[/h3]
Venom Battle Pass can be purchased in-game under the 'Clan' icon. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/fd8b22b95b7eeb559a808bbe5cdfee55a005cb9e.png[/img]
There are three types of Passes in the Venom Battle Pass system. 
[list]
[*] Regular Pass: This Pass is free to every mercenary, all mercenaries are able to obtain the items on this track.
[/list][list
[*] Premium Pass: The Premium track gives mercenaries access to limited rewards such as character and seasonal skins. 
[/list][list]
[*] Premium Pass Bundle: The Premium Pass Bundle gives mercenaries a head start from level8. Also, the bundle contains exclusive content for mercenaries who have purchased it. Exclusive content contains Marek Camo and Diablo Mask.  
[/list]
Once the season ends, the tracks are reset and a new season will start at the scheduled date. 
[i]*All boost, Ammo upgrade, and Smart aim in the Battle Pass are 'timed' items. [/i]

[h3]Instant Level Unlock [/h3]
In the Battle Pass window, mercenaries may purchase levels with Medals. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/02aee2447d24eb6b45202426b76bfd1a2e696f5e.png[/img]

notes.title: AVA Global Release - August 25th!
notes.content:
"A.V.A Global" is an online  FPS game that features online team-play and features a variety of actions using a unique combat system as well as strategic game-play that only "A.V.A Global" can offer.

[h1][b]What's New?[/b][/h1]

[b]Brand New Anti-Cheat - Easy Anti-Cheat (EAC):[/b]
Whether you are a beginner or an experienced mercenary, we will create a fair and balanced environment for all players with the new Easy Anti-Cheat. 

[b]Removal of Pay2Win:[/b]
We understand everyone wants an equitable gameplay experience, so we have taken bold steps to remove Pay2Win. We want all players to enjoy AVA Global for many years to come!

[b]Brand New UI:[/b]
We wanted to give AVA a fresh and modern look. Our team has revised and improved the game. We focused on creating a clean and organized design because we hope to bring you a smooth experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/b1f62fedf57732b96de47d55ad15d7afc7820166.png[/img]

[b]Brand New In-Game Clan System:[/b]
Team up with your friends to start your own clan with the new interface! You may choose to join a clan, modify one, or create your own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/b2c92aa76551e79daf6b3eb19b011c70504dda1f.png[/img]

[b]Brand New Battle Pass:[/b]
We are dedicated to your satisfaction by making sure that development is based on community-centered feedback. The Battle Pass allows you to earn rewards, level up, and have a lot of fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/def8f63fe834783f02295850809a32dbdc4e9254.png[/img]

[b]Exclusive Weapon Skin Tiers:[/b]
There will be 5 brand new skin tiers: yellow, red, purple, green, and gray. Many of the skins are elegant, so choose your tactical load-out and prepare for battle!

[b]Maps & Modes: [/b]
There will be a wide range of maps for you to choose from. New maps and modes will be added with scheduled updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/3806788d158dd2c4a50d911dd47b8afe2a0ce916.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/745f960cda466943081dddbbd025c8e33a1809ee.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/def085702ad48d1bb6617603850c9f3ec8ae1d6c.png[/img]

We hope to bring your the joy of AVA Global for many years to come! 

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: Development Log: Skin Tier System
notes.content:
Hello, Mercenaries!

As promised last week, we would like to share another new feature of the A.V.A Global build. 
This feature is a Skin Tier System, which indicates by color what the rarity of the skin is. 
This color will also be displayed on the kill feed after neutralizing an enemy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1cfe986b75adff43e671b6d17b9adb3191f7261f.png[/img]
The tiers are in descending order of rarity:
1. ????? (Yellow) 
2. Premium (Red) - The item displayed is the Night Flier.
3. Epic (Purple) - The item displayed is the Red Valkyrie.
4. Regular (Green) - The items displayed are the Dreamcatcher & Silvermoon
5. Base (Grey) - The item displayed is the Origin.

How each Skin Tier can be obtained will be disclosed when the build is live. For now, we want to share the division with an example, which you can find below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/21de85e8e1685fb253e9458c6679413b506549e2.png[/img]
Lastly, there is going to be a huge thing coming in August, so leave your notifications on!

Sincerely, 
Your AVA Operations Team
